summary: Plasma Attack is a top-down side scrolling shooter game where the character is a flying spaceship equipped with a base laser.

name: Death at Fleming Manor
summary: "Your job is to write the death certificate." Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.

name: Galaxy Idle Clicker
summary: Embark on an interstellar journey with Galaxy Idle Clicker! Conquer galaxies, upgrade your spaceship, and face off against a myriad of enemy ships. With engaging minigames, powerful upgrades, GIC delivers an unparalleled idle space adventure. Join the cosmic conquest today and dominate the universe!

name: Omega Pilot Evolution
summary: Omega Pilot Evolution is a high-speed futuristic racing experience that pushes the limits of anti-gravity flight. Race in immersive VR or play on a regular screen in both first-person and third-person perspectives, and master precision piloting.

name: The Floor is Lava
summary: The Floor is Lava is a parkour and adventure game with mountains, rocks and even floating objects that defy the law of physics! But remember, if you fall in the lava. You'll have to do it all again!

name: Desert Golfing
summary: Golfing across an endless desert.

name: Cyborg3003
summary: 6-player co-op survival horror at its finest! Cyborg, monsters and aliens. Free updates

name: Handset HQ
summary: Design, build, and sell your own smartphones in Handset HQ! Customize parts, colors, or draw unique shapes. Hire staff, manage R&D and production, and balance costs and prices. Will you create a practical bestseller or a bizarre phone that turns heads?

name: Titan Quest II
summary: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest II, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

name: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop!
summary: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!

name: Task Time ⏰
summary: Task Time is a gameshow inspired competitive party game where 8 friends dive headfirst into 6 rounds of unpredictable tasks and physics-fuelled chaos to finish top of the leaderboard. From (some of) the people that worked on Gang Beasts and Fall Guys, this is the ultimate multiplayer showdown.

name: Project Hospital
summary: Become an ace doctor, an aspiring architect and a successful manager at the same time. Design your very own hospital, tweak every detail or choose one of the prebuilt scenarios and just jump to the doctor’s duty.

name: Parking Master: Drive, Build, Manage
summary: Parking Master is the ultimate parking simulation! Park with precision using real mirrors and advanced car systems. Navigate tight spots, manage your own parking empire across Europe and Japan. Build, expand, and conquer diverse environments!

name: DragonSword : Awakening
summary: Explore the anime-style open world of the Continent of Orbis, brought to life with Unreal Engine 5! Recruit unique companions, unleash spectacular Status Ailment tag-team action, and embark on an epic journey to save the world from the threat of a Dragon reawakened after 60 years.

name: Float Gallery
summary: Float Gallery shows the work of artists working in the digital realm and supports aesthetic and cultural practice in virtual environments. By nature, we define ourselves as a global endeavor, resolving boarders and blending realities in the search of new forms of being, discourse and organization.

name: Huangguoshu Waterfall in Guizhou
summary: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

name: State of Decay 3
summary: Play as a community of survivors, build up your settlements with friends, and destroy zombies in State of Decay 3, the latest in the franchise from developer Undead Labs.

name: Trackmania® Turbo
summary: Trackmania offers you the ultimate arcade racing universe where everything is about reaching the perfect racing time. Test your skills in over 200 tracks, experience immediate fun by challenging your friends at home (offline splitscreen) or online.

name: Startup Company
summary: Startup Company is a business simulation sandbox game where you’re the CEO of a new company. Your job is to build your very own website and compete against the largest tech giants on the planet!

name: Anime Feet 2
summary: The long awaited sequel of Anime Feet series is here! Now with even more feets!

name: Panzer Strategy
summary: Panzer Strategy is a World War II wargame that combines classic turn-based strategy gameplay with modern looks. Command your armies and adapt your units to any objective using a huge selection of real-life military equipment and battle skills.

name: Pawfish Bay
summary: Fish, grill and serve your feline overlords!

name: STAR OCEAN THE DIVINE FORCE
summary: Square Enix and Tri-Ace present the latest title in the Star Ocean RPG series.

name: Inverted Angel
summary: A girl visited your home, who you don't know but she identified herself as your girlfriend. She seems a little bit Menhera, but she knows too much to be just a stalker. This is a Kawaii Future Mystery, you will answer by free input for branching story. Please Try to find out true identity of her.

name: Clay Galaxy
summary: Clay Galaxy is a cozy casual puzzle game set in a unique clay-crafted space universe. Explore small planets, solve logic challenges, and progress location by location to move further.

name: THE GAME OF LIFE 2
summary: The official sequel to the hit board game played by 50 million fans! The Game of Life 2 adds vibrant 3D animation and brand-new choices in every turn. Customise your peg, spin the spinner and build your best life!

name: Laura's secret diary
summary: Help Laura, a female merchant masquerading as a gentleman, pay off her debt and keep her desires in check in this quick-response stylel puzzle game!

name: RoboCop: Rogue City
summary: Become the legendary part man, part machine, all cop hero and deliver justice in Old Detroit.

name: Dysfunctional Systems: Learning to Manage Chaos
summary: From Dischan Media, creators of the highly acclaimed Juniper's Knot, comes Dysfunctional Systems: Learning to Manage Chaos.Dysfunctional Systems is a visual novel series featuring Winter Harrison, a student mediator from a utopian world. Learning to Manage Chaos is the first entry in the series.What is a mediator?

name: Retro Arcade Shop Simulator
summary: Build and manage your ultimate retro arcade! Buy classic Arcade Machines, Galaxy Pinball, and Gift Claw games, or invest in Cinema 8D, Go-Karts, and Racing Simulators. Manage the economy, hire staff, and repair your machines to keep the tokens rolling in!

name: 1 Screen Platformer
summary: This is a SHORT, 2D PLATFORMER with TIGHT CONTROLS about exploring a single level to get past a bunch of TRAPS. There is an EASY mode and a HARD mode depending on your skill level.

name: LEGO® DC Super-Villains
summary: It's good to be bad… Embark on an all-new DC/LEGO® adventure by becoming the best villain the universe has seen. Players will create and play as an all-new super-villain throughout the game, unleashing mischievous antics and wreaking havoc in an action-packed story.

name: Quick Race
summary: Everything you need to do is very simple – just race and over take every other car on the track to win the race! Quick Race is a simple racing game where you can compete with AI or on a split screen with your friend.

name: Oaken Tower
summary: Oaken Tower is a synergy-heavy PvP auto battler where your tower of items fights other players. Build deadly combos and scale exponentially. Every decision matters.

name: Silver Bullet
summary: Silver Bullet is a gothic arcade shooter: blast your way through spooky stages and macabre mini games as Van Helsing, to rescue your pet puppies who were dognapped by Reggie the Vampire!

name: Arrow Tourney
summary: Match2. Step by step you'll have to start thinking to win against your lovely opponents, that will keep distracting you more with less and less cloth on them.

name: DmC: Devil May Cry
summary: In this retelling of Dante's origin story which is set against a contemporary backdrop, DmC Devil May Cry™ retains the stylish action.

name: Acorn Cop
summary: Based on a true story, Acorn Cop is a meme game where you shoot all the acorns, but do NOT shoot any human or other living things. Enjoy and collect easter egg items. Can you do just that for 20 minutes?

name: CharmEdge Deck
summary: A laid-back casual roguelike-DBG game! As a genius mage-swordsman apprentice, build your magic deck, wield Enchantments and Skills, and teach that snarky young mentor a lesson!

name: Colony Survival
summary: Colony Survival is a unique first-person strategy game developed by a two-man team. Build your own colony in a voxel world. Command guards, farmers, miners and other colonists. Defend your colony against the horde of monsters that attacks every night!

name: North Shore
summary: North Shore is a top down skating exploration game in which the player navigates a series of connected waterways. To do so, the player must learn to master the art of skating to effectively navigate through these spaces. As they progress they encounter scenes of natural beauty and danger.

name: Planet Coaster 2
summary: Build and customise thrilling roller coasters and incredible water slides, manage the ultimate theme park experience, and share your epic creations. Are you ready to ride the wave?

name: SAND CRUISER
summary: Sand Cruiser is a colony sim in which the colony drives and fights. Your settlement is a land cruiser crossing a dead desert under a red giant sun. Rebuild it deck by deck, keep its crew alive and drill deep, while a blind swarm under the sand reacts to the noise and heat you make.

name: World Climate Lab
summary: World Climate Lab is a real-time planetary climate simulator. Import your own terrain or sculpt a world in the topography editor, then watch a living climate emerge from physics: winds, oceans, cloud bands and ice. Every climate is calculated, not painted.

name: Mega Man Legacy Collection
summary: Mega Man Legacy Collection is a celebration of the 8-bit history of Capcom’s iconic Blue Bomber featuring faithful reproductions of the series’ origins with the original six Mega Man games.

name: A Kingdom of Soil
summary: Return to a medieval borderland. Rebuild from a hoe, forge, hunt, and reclaim your tavern amid faction conflicts. Words sway deals, cooking wins hearts, choices shape your legacy. Live your legend in an open world.

name: Shotgun Cop Man
summary: GO TO HELL, ARREST SATAN. Propel yourself to justice and glory on a journey through hell in this punchy, crunchy, son-of-a-gun precision platformer from the creator of My Friend Pedro.

name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
summary: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute & cozy puzzle adventure. Play as Traveller, a forest spirit on a special journey, as you explore magical hand-drawn locations, meet charming characters, solve handcrafted puzzles, collect herbs and tea recipes, and help the forest prepare for the coming winter.

name: Turbo Sloths
summary: Turbo Sloths is an adrenaline-fueled shooter-racing game set on another planet, where you drive not a sports car, but a massive turbocharged truck turned into a war machine. Join the insane Wasteland League — here, it's not the fastest who wins, but the strongest.

name: Book of Yog Idle RPG
summary: The Book of Yog is a 3D idle RPG game presented with a Cel-Shading art style. You can rally heroes, develop the kingdom and explore the secrets of a lost world. Dozens of heroes, hundreds of skills, thousands of loot for you to combine freely. Come to embark on a journey to build the strongest team!

name: Little Rocket Lab
summary: Transform your childhood home as you build brilliant factories and forge lifelong friendships, then reach for the skies and finally finish your family's dream - your mother's precious rocket ship. Roll up your sleeves, it turns out that saving this town really IS rocket science!

name: Winter Stealth
summary: Winter Stealth - You have to play as a hired agent who is able to get where the rest can not. Take orders and go on an adventure! Dodge enemies, complete missions and find secret items. Risk everything and go with the hero on a wonderful journey!

name: Epic Palace : Knossos
summary: Immerse yourself in the epic world of the Bronze Age! Rule over the first European civilization and build the famous Palace of Knossos. Be smart in diplomacy and trade, use your gained reputation and equip your throne room with unique frescoes from all over the world.

name: Commander Quest
summary: Congratulations! You just found a 'one of a kind' roguelike that combines deck-building card game and auto battle strategy game! Consider unit counters, then create powerful synergy by breaking down the boundaries between the battlefield and cards, then lead your army to victory!

name: Tennis Elbow Manager 2
summary: Become a tennis coach and manage up to 9 players: take care of training sessions, planning, sponsors, team members, and take control of them on the tennis court if you wish so! Will you be able to lead your players to the top of the world hierarchy?

name: G-MODEArchives+ Persona3 Aigis THE FIRST MISSION
summary: The setting is Yakushima in 1999. A story depicting Aegis' unknown past.

name: Kebab Chefs! - Restaurant Simulator
summary: Kebab Chefs! is a Co-Op, cooking and restaurant management game that can be played up to 4 players. Design your own restaurant. Cook delicious foods, fill your menu with various recipes, feed customers and become the biggest kebab restaurant in town!

name: Jurassic Park: Survival
summary: Return to Isla Nublar the day after the events of the beloved 1993 Jurassic Park film and survive thrilling first-person action as InGen scientist Dr. Maya Joshi in this single-player action-adventure game.

name: Crime Boss: Rockay City
summary: Crime Boss: Rockay City is a 1-4 player co-op FPS heist game with enjoyable stealth and epic killing spree combat. Featuring a solo roguelike campaign that combines FPS and strategy elements with the most hilariously cheesy voice acting that make you laugh.

name: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
summary: From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes a genre-defying experience, now expanded in this definitive DIRECTOR’S CUT. As Sam Bridges, your mission is to deliver hope to humanity by connecting the last survivors of a decimated America. Can you reunite the shattered world, one step at a time?

name: Kingdom III: Rising Realms
summary: Protect your crown! Kingdom returns in an all-new micro-strategy and tower defense game set in a shattered realm. Embark on an atmospheric adventure across lands of legend to build a lasting legacy and challenge the empowered Greed threat.

name: Monster Hunter Stories
summary: Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG that takes the world of Monster Hunter and expands upon it in new and exciting ways! No longer are you hunting monsters, but raising them! In this deep story featuring heroes known as Monster Riders, you will live alongside monsters and form lifelong bonds with them.

name: SCHAR: Blue Shield Alliance
summary: SCHAR: Blue Shield Alliance is a cooperative twin-stick shooter that features a variety of complementing ship classes to choose from. Upgrade your ships, defeat hundreds of enemies, save the galaxy all with some friends from the comfort of your couch.

name: Float Night
summary: Float Night is a small sandbox game that is easy to collect resources, simple to build, no craft, and sustainable.

name: Plants vs. Zombies™ Garden Warfare 2: Deluxe Edition
summary: Ready the Peashooters and prepare for the craziest, funniest shooter in the universe: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare 2.

name: Cannon Brawl
summary: Cannon Brawl is action RTS and artillery hybrid. Pilot an airship, command powerful weapon emplacements and use the destructible terrain to out think and destroy your enemy! It's a new take on artillery strategy!

name: Sticky Business
summary: Experience the joy of running your own cozy small business: Create stickers, pack orders and hear your customers’ stories. Time to build the cutest shop on the internet!

name: Rocketboat - Pilot
summary: Far beyond the reaches of the Milky Way, a great darkness is looming. A clandestine force using powerful social manipulation techniques is controlling the resources of star systems throughout the universe. Their only existential threat appears to be a rock band from the planet Earth.

name: Bugs in Boots
summary: Explore a vast, mysterious, interconnected world made entirely of clay. Meet strange critters, collect forbidden fruit and uncover the mysteries of this place as you journey to see "The Moon" for the first time.

name: Universe Sandbox
summary: Create & destroy on an unimaginable scale with a realistic physics-based space simulator. Explore the beauty of our universe and the fragility of our planet. Use science to bend the laws of gravity, collide planets, boil away oceans, fire epic space lasers, and customize your universe.

name: Midnight Swamp
summary: Midnight Swamp is a dark point-and-click adventure where you will dive into a world of eerie fairy tales. Play as a tourist who must find a way out of a mysterious swamp, where every corner hides a riddle.

name: Heroes' Vow: Three Kingdoms
summary: This Three Kingdoms sandbox RPG lets you do whatever you wish in the late Han Dynasty. Be a ruler, courtier, or hermit. Make friends, marry, raise children, manage estates, train yourself & allies, govern, drill troops, experience & alter history, and conquer all to win the hearts of the people.

name: Call of Duty®: Advanced Warfare - Gold Edition
summary: Call of Duty®: Advanced Warfare envisions a powerful future, where both technology and tactics have evolved to usher in a new era of combat for the franchise.Power Changes Everything.

name: Gold Miner: Party Rush
summary: Gold Miner: Party Rush is a multiplayer party game for 2 to 6 players, bringing the classic Gold Miner crane to head-to-head competition. Grab gold, outlast rivals across frantic rounds, and play with friends or get matched online in Quick Play and Ranked modes.

name: Chronicles: Medieval
summary: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

name: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
summary: You are the one and only Duck Detective, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

name: Void Crew
summary: Void Crew is a Chaotic, Co-op Roguelite game for 1 to 6 players: Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in Space Battles... and try not to panic!

name: STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™
summary: STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ is a free-to-play MMORPG that puts you at the center of your own story-driven saga. Play as a Jedi, Sith, Bounty Hunter, or one of many other iconic STAR WARS roles in the galaxy far, far away over three thousand years before the classic films.

name: Forensics: Crime Scene Detective
summary: Become a forensic specialist in a realistic crime lab simulator. Investigate crime scenes, collect microscopic evidence, and identify perpetrators in the lab using DNA and digital analysis. Based on the experience and insights of experts from the State Criminal Police Office Rhineland-Palatinate.

name: One More Medal: Sports Life Sim
summary: Build an athlete from childhood to the world stage in this pixel sports life sim. Choose talents, train your abilities, navigate life events, and compete in timing-based events. Chase personal bests and carry a talent into your next sporting life.

name: ULTRA0
summary: An easy-to-play, fast-paced 3D shooter meets sci-fi yuri visual novel — a non-stop thrill ride from start to finish!

name: Hotel Tales
summary: Mysterious Hotel between worlds simulator: check in guests, solve their problems, and try to survive whatever it takes! Yeah, your colleagues are seductive ghosts, your clients are lustful mercenaries, and the night shift might end up with a ritual... But hey, at least the paycheck is huge!

name: Winter Memories
summary: After the unforgettable summer memories you’ve made half a year ago, Yui, Rio, and Miyuki are back. With the change of seasons and the cold falling snow, a new page to your story is about to begin.

name: Pronoun Palace
summary: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

name: Anime Feet Aim Trainer
summary: Train your aim with a beautiful selection of anime feet! Shoot the anime girl targets with various weapons, and have a fun time while practicing!

name: Everlusting Life
summary: Everlusting Life — classic auto-chess game set in a fantasy world. Assemble a squad of beautiful girls to aid you on your quest to save the magical realm. Triumph in battles with strategy and win hearts with undeniable charm!

name: MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline
summary: Mega Man X DiVE reimagined the world of the Mega Man X series, and now it's getting an offline version! Strengthen your characters and weapons with a variety of powerups to make them all your own. Then test them out in the side-scrolling action of "what-if" worlds in Mega Man X!

name: Relic Space
summary: Experience deeply simulated, hex-based space combat as an elite starship pilot. Explore a ruined solar system, upgrade your ship, and lead your faction to greatness in this tactical, space RPG with 4X elements.

name: A Sister's Journey
summary: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

name: The Complex: Expedition
summary: When a routine expedition into The Complex goes horribly wrong, you're left alone and lost, wandering the seemingly infinite maze of hallways, otherwise known as the Backrooms. Might there be something following you?

name: Dragon Traveler
summary: Love x Comedy x Isekai = The Ultimate Bishoujo RPG! Welcome to the wild world of Dragon Traveler!

name: Restaurant Simulator
summary: This is a realistic virtual Restaurant where you can order food and chat. Interested in having the restaurant experience from your home? Eat, order, chat and have server wait on you and bring your food.

name: Foto Flash 2
summary: Attention shoppers! The sequel to everyone’s favorite sexy scavenger hunt game is here! Can you save a dying mall by making a pin-up calendar?

name: CURE - A Hospital Simulator
summary: Manage the night shift of an ER during the apocalypse, solo or with friends online: Diagnose patients. Design and grow your hospital, and defend against the undead while treating the living. If you're a creator, connect the game to Twitch and make the audience your patients for even more fun!

name: Gravity Bone
summary: To make it in Nuevos Aires, one needs nerves of silk and the filthiest of hands.

name: Anime City
summary: Anime City is a Japanese high school simulator, focused on anime culture and aesthetics. Study, join school clubs, and make friends.

name: I Got Smoke
summary: Vapes have controlled the world! You will play as a traditional cigarette and overthrone the evil Vape emperor Ruyan. Gunfights, close combat, executions—kill every vape you see, or be killed. I Got Smoke is a pixel-art, top-down shooting game.

name: Extreme Exorcism
summary: Extreme Exorcism is a paranormal platformer where every move you make comes back to haunt you.

name: TBH: Task Bar Hero
summary: The ultimate tiny idle RPG! Adorable pixel heroes are waiting to join your adventure — from your taskbar. Fight off the boredom of work and daily life with diverse classes, skills, items, and builds!

name: Infinity Kingdom
summary: Conquer the city, discover the Infinity! Infinity Kingdom is a cartoon-style mmo strategy game. As a resourceful lord, you must defend the land of Norheim against the evil gnomes while protecting yourself from other invading players!

name: Vampire Mistress
summary: Vampire Mistress is an adult fantasy game with erotic visual-novel story, explicit sex scenes, and 3D point-and-click exploration. Prepare for dark vampire romance! Will you obey your mistress… or betray her?

name: Co-op SNEK Online
summary: Eat dots, get long, don't die. Enjoy classic SNEK gameplay spread over many stages with your friends both online and locally.

name: Cubey Quarry
summary: Mine ores, smelt or grind, get money, build your quarry and repeat.In this small free to play game you slowly build up a quarry, either with your friends or by yourself, it's a perfect game to have running in the background and checking up on every once in a while.

name: Iron Diamond
summary: Explore the mysterious island of Kindara in this vibrant 2D action-adventure. Fight and platform your way through jungles, icy peaks, castles, and crystal caverns in a non-linear interconnected world. Adventure awaits!

name: Hell Clock
summary: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

name: Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop
summary: Come on down to Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop, for all your roguelite spaceship repair simulation needs! WARNING: Untested genre not suitable for people with tentacles for arms or an aversion to dying horrifically. Side effects include improved reading comprehension under pressure and a furry fetish.

name: SONIC PICO PARK
summary: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

name: Wild Ice
summary: Build brutal trap combos and fight alongside your defenses against hordes of Frosties with slapshots and bone-crushing body checks. Between battles explore a handcrafted open world, take on quests, discover upgrades and restore heat to a frozen world in this action-packed tower defense adventure.

name: Street Fighter 30th Anniversary Collection
summary: Celebrate Street Fighter’s historic legacy with the Street Fighter 30th Anniversary Collection. In this collection of 12 Street Fighter games, four groundbreaking titles let you hop online and relive the arcade experience through the online Arcade Mode or play with friends.

name: Rail Capital
summary: Run a railway company in real time, laying track and finding profitable routes for passengers and freight. Buy shares in other companies, invest in factories and try to keep control of your own railway as AI rivals or other players buy into it.

name: The Marsh Manor Mystery
summary: Something strange happened in the old manor, but the Pond's premier puzzle-solver is here to uncover the truth. In this ribbiting and cozy mystery, explore the grounds, journey into the past, and unearth the secrets buried at Marsh Manor.

name: Drift On Destiny Line
summary: Drift on Destiny Line is a game where racing and school life collide. Follow a young man from small-town roots as he steps into the collage and dark underground racing world. Meet seven girls different personalities. Build relationships and make choices that shape your destiny. Win or lose!

name: Summer Beach
summary: Summer Beach is the spiritual successor to Sexy Beach, an adult 3D dating simulation game where you can develop relationships with multiple girls with different personalities, run a "beach maid bar," go diving, fishing, rent motorcycles for a ride... ...a youthful tale by the sea.

name: Water You Doing?
summary: Your ride is dead, and rough waters lie ahead! Survive aboard a musty boat in a totally chaotic co-op. Collect scrap, patch up leaks, swap your catch for cold brews, and use harpoons to break the laws of physics!

name: Bone Voyage
summary: Bone Voyage is a third person adventure game set on a Vessel to the Afterlife. Use your skeletal body to your advantage and explore the ship in unique ways to uncover the mystery of the ship and its inhabitants!

name: Wheel of Death
summary: Spin the wheel... or die. Wheel of Death is a dangerously addictive deck-builder where you'll spin Death's wheel, changing your fate with powerful Tarot card combos, rule-breaking chips, illegal contraband, and a wheel where the numbers go up!

name: Hop Step Sing! Nozokanaide Naked Heart (HQ Edition)
summary: Enjoy the song and performance in this VR music video set in a virtual world. This time, your destination is a magic factory where the wounded hearts of the world go to be healed. As the girls' leader, it's your job to bring a smile back to the world!

name: ARK: Survival Ascended
creators: Studio Wildcard / Grove Street Games / Instinct Games
summary: ARK is reimagined from the ground-up into the next-generation of video game technology with Unreal Engine 5! Form a tribe, tame & breed hundreds of unique dinosaurs and primeval creatures, explore, craft, build, and fight your way to the top of the food-chain. Your new world awaits!

name: Fast Royal
summary: Fast Royal is a battle royale game that distills the adrenaline of traditional titles into their most intense final moments, all set in a fully destructible arena. You drop straight into the action, the storm is already closing in. No time to waste! Gear up and fight to be the last one standing.

name: Swamp Keeper
summary: Swamp Keeper is a Korean-style bow action arena shooter inspired by one-shot, one-kill gameplay. You are the "Swamp Keeper," defender of the sacred swamp, armed with only a bow to repel invading enemies. Master the art of archery, defeat waves of foes, and take down their commander.

name: Hospital Rhapsody
summary: Build your hospital and form special bonds. From daily management to private moments, discover their stories amid the bustle of work. As trust and affection grow, uncover another side beneath the white coat…

name: Rest Area Simulator: Prologue
summary: Take over the gas station and convenience store at a roadside rest area and expand by purchasing new businesses. Manage a living world shaped by dynamic economy and random events. Upgrade your facilities, satisfy your customers, and play solo or with friends.

name: Luna Abyss
summary: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.

name: Military Incremental Complex
summary: Make weapons, make money. An active incremental game where you amass as much money as you can by starting a Military Industrial Complex company. Produce multiple different weapons, research upgrades, manipulate the stock market, and lobby the government for favors.

name: One Potion Please
summary: NSFW expansion themed potion crafting puzzle game! Mix kink-themed potions to inflate boobs, bwomph butts, and more, in this comedic and lewd fantasy world.

name: SWAT Commander
summary: Take charge of a SWAT unit as an elite operator. Command a specialized AI squad or team up in co-op to seize suspects, rescue civilians, and restore order. Study the briefing, kit out your team, and execute your plan with disciplined precision.

name: Alien Shooter
summary: The endless darkness and the somber, long passages of a military complex have become the abode of evil, thousands of blood-thirsty creatures fill its offices, storehouses and mysterious laboratories. About 1,000 monsters on each map, showing up to 100 monsters simultaneously on one playing screen.

name: Indie Game Sim
summary: Become an indie game developer! Make your own games by hand and publish them on a fantasy market like Steam. Earn fans, receive brutal reviews, and battle your inner demons. Can you become the creator of your dreams?

name: Light Work
summary: In this first person experience, you are returning home after a long day of work. Turn off all of the lights on each floor of the office before you depart. Use the elevator to travel between floors, and be on the lookout for any unusual behavior from your coworkers.

name: Settlement Survival
summary: In this city-building game, you will lead a group of survivors in their search for a new home. Manipulate the landscape, manage limited supplies, plant crops, hunt wildlife, gather resources, and develop trade routes to build a bustling and unique town.

name: Pirate Ships
summary: Pirate Ships is a PvP game about shipbuilding and naval battles. Embark on an epic journey together with other players and fight monsters, pirates and thieves to become the greatest pirate in all of the Caribbean!

name: Geyserlands
summary: Geyserlands is a deck-building game of modern otherworldly mystery. Gain new cards and upgrade your deck as you explore the mystery of Geyserlands. Unlock secret powers and gain special advantages. How will your story end in Geyserlands?

name: Cooking Craze
summary: Cooking Craze is a fast and fun cooking game that lets you explore the cultures of the world through their delicious food! Upgrade your restaurants to serve only the best dishes and use a variety of special boosts to cook your way to victory!

name: Battle Axe
summary: A classic arcade hack and slash brought to life with stunning pixel art and a heroic soundtrack. Choose your champion and battle through waves of enemies to stop a dark sorceress from plunging Mercia into eternal darkness.

name: AURA: Hentai Cards
summary: AURA: Hentai Cards is a fascinating 2D erotic visual novel and collectible card game where magic, romance, and adventure come together! Build your harem by seducing women and save the world from the Demon Queen, or join her army!

name: Titan Chaser
summary: Titan Chaser is a surreal driving and walking experience, meant to evoke a feeling of being lost and discovering something mystical at your own pace instead of structured gameplay mechanics. Your job here is to scout giant creatures and scare them away without fighting or killing.

name: Too Deep To Quit
summary: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

name: Maid Mansion
summary: A young man inherits his grandfather's mansion on one condition: He can never fire the head maid. Now he is the lord of the manor, free to pursue all his perverse desires...

name: Horse Tales: Emerald Valley Ranch
summary: Set off on a captivating horseback adventure and discover the mysteries of Emerald Valley!

name: Mercenary Leto
summary: A cozy visual novel with light platforming and lots of heart. Come pet the fluffy dragon!

name: METAL GEAR SOLID: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
summary: From Naked Snake to Big Boss. Ten years after Operation Snake Eater. While commanding a private military force in Colombia, guests from Costa Rica visit Snake. Accepting their request, Snake leads his men into confronting the conspiracy behind the East-West Cold War.

name: Fire Pro Wrestling World
summary: The greatest grappling game returns to take on the world! Customize every aspect of the match, from your wrestler to the ring itself, in your fight for the championship belt.

name: Room No. 9
summary: It's up to you to decide how far you're willing to go in order to survive in this psychological thriller visual novel about two best friends trapped in an experiment. Can these two men survive their choices between physical and psychological harm long enough to earn freedom?

name: Plane Accident
creators: White Pig Games / Spirit Games Studio
summary: Become an inspector examining causes of plane crashes. Visit the crash site, gather evidence and interrogate witnesses. Explain whether the accident was caused by independent factors or human errors.

name: Summer Trip Cruise
summary: Hey you, we need a captain! Use your mouse to drive the cruise ship with the on-screen rudder, avoid obstacles, take pictures and enjoy the ride. Take it easy... or take the challenge!

name: Tower of Babel: Survivors of Chaos
summary: Bullet Heaven x Endless Loot! Create Your Own Build in this Roguelite Action RPG.

name: Rapid Miner
summary: Rapid Miner is a desktop idler: a tiny pixel mine floats in the corner of your screen in Pocket Mode, and your typing and clicks keep the miner swinging while you work. Open the full game to explore caves, beat bosses, grow a village and Rebirth.

name: WRATH: Aeon of Ruin
summary: Blast, slice and shred through your enemies in this hardcore FPS inspired by the icons of the '90s, powered by the legendary Quake-1 Tech. Taking place in a realm left to rot, take up arms, unearth long-forgotten secrets and hunt down the Guardians of the Old World.

name: The Cruise 2
summary: Top down 2D sci-fi space themed roguelike bullet hell shooter with different player classes and abilities to play with.

name: Everyday Shooter
summary: Everyday Shooter is an album of games exploring the expressive power of abstract shooters. Dissolute sounds of destruction are replaced with guitar riffs harmonizing over an all-guitar soundtrack, while modulating shapes celebrate the flowing beauty of geometry.

name: The Trench
summary: This is a post ww1 horror game about a soldier coming back to the trench he was stationed at and the events that happened there. You will find out the truth and uncover what happened there as you also find a way to move one from the past.

name: TrophyRC
summary: TrophyRC — a scale off-road trial experience. Customize your crawler and conquer challenging obstacle courses. Remember, it's not about speed, but accuracy and precision!

name: Chaos Galaxy
summary: A pixel-art turn-based Galaxy total war game. You can select 14 factions, 61 heroes, hundreds of warships and mecha, and command multiple fleets to carry out grand strategic operations on the map of the galaxy.

name: Ninja and the Quest for the Jade Statue
summary: Silently race through the town on your quest to collect every piece of the jade statue in this single-button platform-hell rage-game .

name: Erotic Fantasy Camp
summary: Arrive at Fantasy Camp for fun and relaxation, only to uncover mysteries that awaken more than curiosity. Build intimate bonds with the camp counsellor and other members as desire, danger, and passion intertwine across every wild corner of nature.

name: The Monstrous Horror Show
summary: Four girls find their way into an abandoned hospital, each for her own reasons. Will they manage to unravel the dark secrets hiding within, escape safely, and return to their normal, peaceful lives?

name: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
summary: A third-person medieval dark fantasy adventure RPG with survival horror elements. As Edgar, a former priest with a fractured memory, explore a ruined world, solve environmental puzzles and uncover its secrets. Face twisted creatures and perform exorcisms to free the possessed.

name: Supreme Commander: Forged Alliance
summary: The last days of man are at hand.. Two years after the Infinite War the once great warring nations now lie in ruins, and humanity’s hope for a brighter future is nothing but a bitter memory. A new, seemingly unstoppable enemy, supported by the zealots of The Order, now seeks to eradicate mankind: UEF, Aeon Loyalist, and Cybran alike.

name: Kingdom Two Crowns
summary: Gather coins, build defenses and reclaim your fallen Kingdom. Explore and uncover secrets, unlock new technologies and protect your crown versus waves of Greed monsters that come at night. Kingdom is a solo or co-op micro-strategy and tower defense game set in an atmospheric pixel world.

name: Mega Man X Legacy Collection 2
summary: Complete the exciting Mega Man X saga with four action-packed titles! This collection showcases the evolution of the series with Mega Man X5, Mega Man X6, Mega Man X7, and Mega Man X8. Test your skills in the new X Challenge mode, which pits players against two deadly bosses at once.

name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27
summary: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

name: Thunder Tank: Iron Shield
summary: A relaxing strategy idle shooter that blends bullet hell action with backpack-like inventory management. Pilot your vehicle through a desolate, post-modern world, conquer 20 difficulty levels, collect diverse weapons, and build the ultimate firepower lineup to survive the wasteland.

name: Gloria Victis: Medieval MMORPG
summary: Gloria Victis is an MMORPG with an emphasis on realism, set in a low-fantasy medieval open world. Enjoy MMO with skill-based non-target combat, open PVP with territory control, deep crafting system and player-driven economy – all that served with beautiful graphics and an immersive atmosphere.

name: Driver® Parallel Lines
summary: You were the fastest wheelman on the street. You were a legend. You were money. Until they set you up and sent you down. Twenty-eight years inside for someone else's crime. Now you're getting out. Guess what? You got a new job, it's called getting revenge.

name: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition
summary: Injustice: Gods Among Us Самое полное издание от компании NetherRealm Studios представляет собой смелую новаторскую разработку в жанре файтинговых игр. В этом мощном издании шесть новых игровых персонажей, более 30 новых костюмов и новые миссии Лаборатории С.Т.А.Р.

name: Fight Angel Special Edition
summary: Fight Angel is the girl fighting game with great customization functions with physical effects that make realistic boobs movements and clothing destruction systems. Let's fight the challenger with your partner! This is a special edition of Fight Angel.

name: High On Life 2
summary: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

name: Camp Whittlewood
summary: Camp Whittlewood is an old-school horror RPG. You've been dropped off for a weekend of outdoor fun, but soon find bullies are the least of your problems when a twisted campfire story begins to come true.

name: Army of Ruin
summary: Wreak havoc on countless foes with mighty weapons and deadly spells! Enhance your skills and face even greater dangers! Army of Ruin is an auto-shooter where you become the Bullet Hell.

name: Aperture Desk Job
summary: Introducing Aperture Desk Job — a free playable short made for the Steam Deck, set in the universe of the modestly popular Portal games.

name: Stellar Blade™
summary: Save humanity from extinction in post-apocalyptic action-adventure Stellar Blade™. Experience blistering combat and a twisting storyline as you unravel the mysteries of Earth’s downfall.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Daemonhunters
summary: Lead humanity’s greatest weapon, the Grey Knights, in this fast-paced turn-based tactical RPG. Root out and purge a galaxy-spanning plague in a cinematic, story-driven campaign, using the tactics and talents of your own personalised squad of Daemonhunters.

name: Medal Mania: Coin Pusher
summary: Drop coins. Push them forward. Grow your fortune. Get stronger. A fresh take on the 3D physics-based coin pusher, combining random skill choices, rare coins with unique abilities, and idle progression.

name: The Cosmic Wheel Sisterhood
summary: Immerse yourself in an enchanting narrative experience as Fortuna, a fortune-teller Witch condemned to exile on her asteroid home. Craft your own Tarot deck, regain your freedom, and shape the fate of the cosmic Witch society.

name: In Stars And Time
summary: Live with the ever-present burden of being trapped in a time loop only you can know about in this turn-based RPG. Create a better future for you and your friends. Find hope where there is none left. Pray to the stars and free yourself from time.

name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
creators: Ubisoft Singapore / Ubisoft Barcelona / Ubisoft Bordeaux / Ubisoft Belgrade / Ubisoft Chengdu / Ubisoft India / Ubisoft Kyiv / Ubisoft Montpellier / Ubisoft Philippines / Ubisoft Quebec / Ubisoft Shanghai / Ubisoft Montreal / Ubisoft Romania
summary: The iconic solo pirate adventure returns. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content.

name: Backyard Baseball
summary: The arcade-style classic is back - and it's leveling up. With enhanced gameplay, new game modes, and all the humor & charm of the original, this is Backyard Baseball like it was always meant to be played. Are you ready to play like a kid again?

name: Waterpark Simulator
summary: Build and run your own waterpark solo or with friends. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!

name: Pilot Brothers 2
summary: Join the famed duo in their search for the serial maniac!

name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
summary: An Oni Gauntlet-wielding samurai makes a stand in Kyoto against the encroaching Genma menace. Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

name: RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army
summary: The story of apprentice detective and Devil Summoner extraordinaire Raidou Kuzunoha XIV returns in this remastered classic! Call upon your demons to solve supernatural mysteries and dispose of enemies.

name: ShoreTiles
summary: Build your island around a fragile lighthouse in this Gloomy tile-placement strategy game. Balance growth, economy, and defense - because when night falls, THEY will rise from the depths.

name: City Transport Simulator 2026 - Bus & Tram
summary: City Transport Simulator 2026 combines a detailed bus simulator and tram simulator in one game. Drive realistic buses and trams, create routes and timetables, manage your fleet, and build your own public transport network in a dynamic European-inspired city.

name: Severed Steel
summary: An intense single-player FPS featuring a stylish movement system, completely destructible levels, and an acclaimed OST.

name: Assassin’s Creed Shadows
creators: Ubisoft Quebec / Ubisoft Belgrade / Ubisoft Bordeaux / Ubisoft Bucharest & Craiova / Ubisoft Chengdu / Ubisoft Montpellier / Ubisoft Montreal / Ubisoft Osaka / Ubisoft Philippines / Ubisoft Shanghai / Ubisoft Singapore / Ubisoft Sofia / Ubisoft Ukraine
summary: Experience an epic action-adventure story set in feudal Japan! Become a lethal shinobi assassin and powerful legendary samurai as you explore a beautiful open world in a time of chaos.

name: The Bus
summary: Transport passengers in the city bus simulation The Bus along 1:1 scale routes in Berlin, passing landmarks like the Victory Column, Brandenburg Gate, and Alexanderplatz. In the Scania Citywide LF and other licensed buses, sell tickets, handle traffic, and get everyone to their destination safely.

name: ULTRAKILL
summary: ULTRAKILL es un juego de disparos en primera persona (FPS) retro, trepidante y ultraviolento, que combina el sistema de puntuación basado en la habilidad de los juegos de acción con personajes con la carnicería sin límites inspirada en los mejores shooters de los años 90.

name: Axe Cop
summary: Fight all of the bad guys! Axe Cop and his team of colorful characters must go on an epic adventure, that covers his ten-year comic book history, to rid the world of all bad guys once and for all in this epic turn-based RPG!

name: Sniper Elite: Resistance
summary: Offering unparalleled sniping mechanics, stealth and tactical third-person combat, Sniper Elite: Resistance turns the attention of the award-winning series towards a hidden war, far from the front lines, deep within the heart of occupied France.

name: Blood Dungeon
summary: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

name: NINJA GAIDEN 2 Black
summary: Using Unreal Engine 5 to significantly enhance graphic expression, this is the definitive version of "NINJA GAIDEN 2," featuring additional playable characters and enhanced battle support functions.

name: Rec Room: A New Semester
summary: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

name: Clear the Snow
summary: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!

name: LIVING HELL
summary: A co-op horror where you must escape a city in ruins, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations. From the creator of DEVOUR.

name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
summary: A brand-new action RPG from the creators of OCTOPATH TRAVELER and BRAVELY DEFAULT – The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales combines stunning HD-2D visuals and exciting action-adventure gameplay for the first time!

name: Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Mega Mix+
summary: Take center stage in Hatsune Miku’s premier rhythm game starring the world’s #1 virtual pop star! With a stunner setlist and enormous wardrobe to style, it’s Miku’s ultimate tour—all it needs is you.

name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
summary: SpeedRunners 2 is a high-speed multiplayer platformer where rival superheroes face off in breakneck races using parkour, grappling hooks, and game-changing power-ups. Fall behind, and a shrinking ring of fire eliminates you – until only one runner remains.

name: Warlocks Quarry
summary: Use your skills in looting, fighting, exploring and base building to survive and progress in Warlocks world.

name: Paluah's Trench
summary: An underwater narrative horror game where you must journey to the bottom of a deep-sea trench and uncover its mysteries.

name: iRacing Arcade
summary: Race across global licensed series and build your own racing team to secure your motorsport legacy in this third person arcade racer.

name: Crash Bandicoot™ 4: It’s About Time
creators: Toys for Bob / Beenox / Activision Shanghai / Hardsuit Labs / Iron Galaxy Studios
summary: It’s About Time - the critically-acclaimed Crash Bandicoot™ 4: It's About Time is now on Steam!

name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
creators: Infinity Ward / Beenox / Digital Legends / Activision Shanghai / Raven Software / Treyarch / Sledgehammer Games / High Moon Studios
summary: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

name: In Ukrainian Soil
summary: Soar through the transcendental realm and guide lost souls to heaven's gates in this rhythm-fueled psychodelic racing game.

name: Devil Spire Falls
summary: The open-world action-RPG, where you can do anything, of your dreams… as if it came out 30 years ago!

name: WATER ZERO
summary: The water never stops rising. Water Zero is a high-stakes survival platformer about an unstoppable vertical escape. Control a robot, execute precise mechanical moves, dodge deadly obstacles, and reach the top before you get submerged. Every second matters.

name: Capital Island
summary: Play as a Door-to-Door seller in this trade/management game.

name: The Shore
summary: THE SHORE is a first person story driven game with an atmospheric environment and narrations, You will encounter mysterious creatures and unravel the secrets behind them. Strong elements of horror, struggle to survive an unknown world that will make you question your own sanity.

name: SkullX: Aibohphobia
summary: You were hired to extract a bioengineer. Now your team is cut off, your comms are dead, and you're surrounded by something wearing human skin. Hold the line, make the calls, and survive the night in this choice-driven visual novel with turn-based combat.

name: RollerCoaster Tycoon®: Deluxe
summary: One of the best games from acclaimed Tycoon series, with well designed gameplay mechanics, appealing graphics, and really high re-playability value. There’s no limit to what you can create so design and build the most thrilling roller coaster the world has ever seen!

name: Old School RuneScape
summary: The best retro fantasy MMORPG on the planet. Old School is RuneScape but… older! This is the open world you know and love, but as it was in 2007. Saying that, it’s even better than that – Old School is shaped by you, its players, with regular new content, fixes and expansions voted for by the fans!

name: Lost Continent
summary: This is a 2D pixel card battle game, in which players take on the role of adventurers, building their own cards and teams, controlling their characters to fight enemies on the chessboard, gradually strengthening their teams and constructing decks.Defeating the boss and protect the continent.

name: Potion Permit
summary: Moonbury's residents need healing, and you're the best chemist around! With your trusty tools, a brewing cauldron, and a canine companion at your side, you'll need to diagnose symptoms, gather ingredients, brew potions, and cure ailments in this open-ended sim RPG.

name: Metropolis: Lux Obscura
summary: A unique game with a film noir atmosphere, seductive wanton women, and dirty dangerous secrets. Gameplay is based on a motion comic with a non-linear plot mixed with MATCH3 puzzle fights.

name: Wind Up
summary: Wind Up is a multiplayer game focusing on social deduction, cooperation, and betrayal. In a complex haunted castle, the clockwork dolls outsmart imposters hiding among them. Who can escape the castle? Who will be banished? Who will be killed by imposters when night falls...

name: Magma Tsunami
summary: Magma Tsunami is a frenzied arcade platformer game. Beat your records in 1P or Co-op mode, and don't get caught by the Magma Tsunami!!! Could you stay alive for more than one minute??

name: Anime Feet
summary: Anime Feet... A more powerful combo of words doesn't exist. Play our exclusive Puzzle formula and unlock fresh cute anime gal feet for you to appreciate UwU

name: Geometry Dash
summary: Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer!

name: Pivot Pilot
summary: Pivot Pilot is a challenging platformer with puzzle elements in which you take simultaneous control of a boy and a giant robot arm.

name: MECCHA HORROR
summary: Two games in one! Descend into a co-op horror survival roguelite. PAINT, RUN, and HIDE to SURVIVE! Grow STRONGER with unique upgrades every run! █A█R█G█ Relax and paint your way through a colorful roguelite, or battle your “friends” in PvP to prove WHO is the ULTIMATE ARTIST!

name: Plants vs. Zombies™: Replanted
summary: The classic Plants vs. Zombies returns in glorious HD! The original battle between Plants and Zombies is back — bigger, brighter, and crazier than ever before! Experience the game that started it all, now remastered with stunning HD graphics and packed with new secrets and content to uncover.

name: Bouncy Cloud
summary: Bounce through the skies and capture the flag! Each platform is one use only, leaving you with fewer options to traverse back and capture the flag you worked so hard to collect.

name: Monkey Gang
summary: Monkey Gang is an autobattler based on teamwork, where you can create a team of monkeys for fighting waves of enemies! Create strategies, unlock new monkeys, buy upgrades and make unique teams to reach the furthest you can!

name: Urban Jungle
summary: Use luscious plants to turn your ordinary home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your small apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet your cat!

name: Worlds Upon The Wind
summary: Restore the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

name: Farmer Charm
summary: In this roguelike autobattler, collect unusual combinations of farmers and artifacts, discover hidden mechanics and secret builds.

name: Code RAPID
summary: Code RAPID is a Third-Person Action Mecha game with the focus on real-time high-mobility movement. Fight on the Ondarean front to uncover mysteries of a forgotten planet. Complete missions to earn weapons and parts to build a mech that truly suits your playstyle with deep customization systems.

name: Bramble: The Mountain King
summary: Bramble The Mountain King is a grim adventure set in a world inspired by dark, Nordic fables. Explore the beautiful yet dangerous and twisted land of Bramble in your endeavour to rescue your sister. Traverse a wondrous landscape and survive deadly encounters with Bramble's many hideous creatures.

name: Police Station Simulator
summary: You’re in charge of a run-down police station. Will you manage to restore it to its former glory? Arm yourself with some coffee and donuts, because there's a lot of renovation and micro-management work to do!

name: Blacklist Mafia
summary: Blacklist Mafia - is not only a struggle for power and money, but also a dangerous game of survival. Who will be blacklisted, and who will become the new boss? Find out with us!

name: Beyond the Ice Palace 2
summary: Arise from the dead as the 'Cursed King' in an enthralling action platformer. Wield the chains that once imprisoned you to vanquish foes and traverse your fallen kingdom. Uncover hidden areas, strategically level up, and reclaim your throne by banishing colossal bosses!

name: Murders on the Yangtze River
summary: "Murders on Yangtze River" is an Ace Attorney-like detective game that takes you on a journey through early 20th century China as you solve a series of intriguing cases. Use your logical reasoning and deduction skills to uncover clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the mysteries.

name: Topidia: The Last Badge
summary: Become the greatest explorer, find the last badges you are missing, and most importantly, be the first to discover Topidia!

name: Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Colonization
summary: Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Colonization is the third offering in the award winning Civilization IV series. A re-imagining of the classic Colonization game Sid Meier created in 1994, Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Colonization is a total conversion of the Civilization IV engine into a game experience in which players will lead a European...

name: Plasma Sky
summary: This week, every pilot on Earth flies the same new seeded run: identical enemies, identical drops, pure skill. Flow through alien formations, arm your wingmen, and power up when you can. Out-score your friends in Plasma Sky, an arcade shmup with over 100 handcrafted levels. Blast into the neon sky!

name: Back in the Swamp
summary: A first-person point-and-click exploration adventure set in a mysterious post-apocalyptic swamp filled with giant insects and abandoned robots. Observe your surroundings, find the right objects, and progress through the ruins in this 3–4 hour atmospheric journey.

name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma
summary: Welcome to the eastern nation of Azuma! In this fresh take on Rune Factory, use your powers as an Earth Dancer to restore the land, its people, and even its gods. Along the way, battle corrupted monsters, rebuild seasonal farms and villages, and form bonds with the colorful locals.

name: Return to Ash
summary: “The hospital was empty. Quiet, and brighter than usual... like waking up on a snow day. But I didn't feel cold. I didn't feel much of anything.”

name: Soldier Warfare
summary: Action shooter game with tactical combat and realistic gameplay experence.

name: Hyper Jam
summary: Battle it out local and online in this neon-soaked arena brawler full of lethal weapons, stackable perks, furious combat and a killer synthwave soundtrack.

name: Expedition: Into Darkness
summary: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

name: Hyper Echelon
summary: The Cyan Galaxy is in peril! Your trusty little star fighter and rag tag squad of wingmen are the only hope against the evil EXODON! Level up from a pea shooter to an offensive powerhouse as you engage in frantic combat across many wondrous locales.

name: Summer at Smile Café
summary: Set out on a journey of love and smiles with 8 women in this 2D interactive adventure. You're a freelance artist who's working at home, getting scorched by the summer heat. So, you take your gear to the Smile Café! There's no way you could predict the escapades that are about to unfold...

name: Nedi Cloud Simulator
summary: You are a little rain cloud over grey, dead floating islands. Hold to rain and watch grass, flowers and trees burst back to life. Wake rivers and waterfalls, find lost seeds and heal a sky full of islands. Relax, or chase gold medals and race the rival clouds.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
summary: Take on the role of one of the notorious Slaughter family, or their victims, in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, a third-person asymmetrical horror experience based on the groundbreaking and iconic 1974 horror film. Experience the mad and macabre for yourself in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre.

name: Fish Lab
summary: A short incremental game where you collect fish for your lab. Synced to music.

name: Cattle Country
summary: Howdy partner! Welcome to Cattle Country, the Cozy Cowboy Adventure Life Sim. Become a determined pioneer traveling west to start a new life. Make a home in the mountains, take on bandits, discover dastardly plots, build a farm, develop your town, and make friends with fellow residents.

name: Chest Buster
summary: An incremental battle game where destroying treasure chests instantly brings item effects into battle to fight enemies. Break all the seals on the Abyss Chest and liberate the great being who will save the world!

name: Motor Town: Behind The Wheel
summary: Enjoy realistic driving in the open world. Relaxing cargo deliveries or driving buses and taxis will give you enough money to buy new cars and parts. You can test your driving skills at the race track. It's all about pure driving pleasure!

name: Farming Simulator 17
summary: Take on the role of a modern farmer in Farming Simulator 17! Explore farming possibilities in a new North American environment. Drive over 250 farming vehicles and equipment from over 75 manufacturers, including new brands such as Challenger, Fendt, Valtra or Massey Ferguson.

name: Nature Game System
summary: Now includes Jurassic, Flight, and Arctic Tundra! Adapt your species to survive where food is scarce and predators lurk at every turn. Easy to learn, but offering lots of strategic depth, Nature is a modular game system from the designer of the award-winning Evolution series.

name: Mega Man Zero/ZX Legacy Collection
summary: Mega Man Zero/ZX Legacy Collection brings together six classic titles in one game: Mega Man Zero 1, 2, 3 and 4, as well as Mega Man ZX and ZX Advent. The collection also features Z-Chaser, an exclusive new mode created just for this set of games.

name: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders
summary: Crash over and over until you master the mountain in the snowy followup to Lonely Mountains: Downhill. Now also including 2-8 person crossplatform multiplayer - work your way down the slopes together as a group, or risk it all in a breakneck race to the base!

name: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter
summary: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter reimagines the first chapter of a beloved series, infusing it with enhanced visuals and refined gameplay. Join Estelle and Joshua, partners bound by fate, as they unravel dark conspiracies threatening the peace of the Liberl Kingdom.

name: Wet Sand
summary: An erotic point-and-click adventure featuring VN & dating sim elements. Follow the adventures of Fabian Brook and his crew in Savage Waters as they explore the world, meet unique sea creatures, and indulge in sexual shenanigans.

name: PEPPERED: an existential platformer
summary: An existential platformer where Doomsday is just around the corner. Save the world or become an eternal corporate slave for the God of Death. Choices matter. Or do they? Goof around and find out.

name: Phantom Spark
summary: The best feeling racing game out there. Precision time-trial racing against npc champions in the campaign or other players on the leaderboards.

name: Finding Ruby: Hidden Object Adventure
summary: 🔍🐱 A cozy hidden object adventure to enjoy with a cup of tea. Search 15 richly detailed scenes as Ruby and her companions follow the trail of her missing archaeologist parents. No timers, no fail states — just a thousand small things waiting to be found.

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
summary: TMNT Splintered Fate - Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

name: Thicc Magic. Perky Prelude
summary: The backstory of our kindest, fairest, most humble, and selfless ruler, in the form of a comedic hentai shoot 'em up.

name: Plasma
summary: Plasma is a pure engineering sandbox. Use advanced visual programming and robotics tools to create anything you can imagine.

name: Monk Took Book
summary: A game about organizing, stacking and remembering where you put hundreds of books in a cozy-creepy medieval library. Play solo or with up to three fellow monks.

name: SPARK IGNITES
summary: Spark Ignites - A pixel fantasy RPG where the Star God's Blessing grants one wish each century. Orphan Ash and Clover uncover its bloody truth during their pilgrimage. Holding a world-changing secret, will you steal divine power or defy the gods? Every choice writes a new ending.

name: Cursed Armor 2
summary: Lilina returns in the official sequel to Cursed Armor: a dark fantasy RPG with transformations, steamy scene variations, and high-stakes choices. After gaining the power of the Spirit Witch, her cursed journey begins anew.

name: Castlevania Dominus Collection
summary: Three incredible action adventure games from the Castlevania series have finally returned, for the first time! But wait, there's more! Haunted Castle Revisited, a redesigned version of the very first Castlevania arcade game, makes its debut!

name: Siege Hammer
summary: Siege Hammer is an entry-level VR game created for the entire family to enjoy. Uniquely-designed for comfort, it delivers hours of fun-filled playtime. Are you the hammer…. Or the anvil?

name: Sven Co-op
summary: Sven Co-op is a co-operative game originally based around Valve Software's Half-Life. In this game players must work together against computer controlled enemies and solve puzzles as a team.

name: Shotgun Legend
summary: Eugene must battle aliens and the undead in search of a truck rim, as it seems to be his ticket home.

name: Wicked Island
summary: Survive a harsh, alluring open world in this 18+ survival RPG. Craft gear, build your home, customize your character, and command dragons! Explore deep dungeons and battle fierce monsters. Fight to win, or succumb to your desires with a fully integrated sex defeat and pregnancy system.

name: Dumpster Gang
summary: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

name: BOMBANANA!
summary: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

name: Idle Colony
summary: A condensed incremental experience, where you build a colony to collect and merge bigger and bigger fruits. Combine game-changing technologies and special upgrades to find the best synergies and take your cash flow to another dimension.

name: Enterprise - Space Agency Simulator
summary: Take the helm of a cutting-edge space agency with the mission to explore and exploit the Solar system. Realize the historical, and futuristic mission to establish humanity as the Interplanetary species.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

name: Crafting Dead
summary: Crafting Dead is a post-apocalyptic multiplayer-based zombie survival game with a voxel theme. Aim high and punch low, survive at all costs!

name: GARBAGE COUNTRY
summary: Garbage Country is a post-apocalyptic exploration sim from the creator of Cloud Gardens and Kingdom: New Lands. Drive across a handcrafted wasteland. Repel waves of enemy bots in tense tower-defense battles. Upgrade your car to travel further into the forgotten world buried under the dust.

name: There Is No Game: Wrong Dimension
summary: There is no game. So don't go messing things up by clicking everywhere. You don’t want to be kicked out of your video game world, do you? Of course not!

name: Firestone – Idle Clicker Online RPG
summary: Your heroes never stop fighting. Build an unstoppable team in a fantasy idle RPG with AFK progression and offline rewards. Collect heroes and powerful gear, master formations, defeat epic bosses, and return to bigger rewards and endless incremental growth.

name: Star Ring
summary: 长篇×乙女向×模拟养成 欢迎来到星之诗学院！追求梦想的你，就是未来最璀璨的明星。——九种职业路线，七位可攻略角色，丰富的游戏系统，打造独一无二的演艺圈传奇。

name: Ultimate Scroll
summary: This is a casual card game set in the backdrop of cultivation-themed Xianxia world. In this game, players control cultivators who challenge demon caves, search for treasures in the treasure pavilion, and overcome tribulations in the heavenly tower to enhance their cultivation levels.

name: Anime Hunter
summary: Anime girls versus crazy hunter! Hit girls with dildos to steal their underwear. Crazy, insane, incredible game!

name: Witching Stone
summary: Witching Stone is a puzzle game matched with a deckbuilder! Customise your spellbook and weave spells with coloured stones.

name: Morbid Metal
summary: Morbid Metal is a hack-and-slash action rogue-lite where you shapeshift into powerful characters. Switch in real time to unleash unique combos and slaughter hordes of deadly machines and intense bosses.

name: Smoke and Steel
summary: Lead a nation through early 18th-century Europe in Smoke and Steel, a turn-based wargame combining grand strategy with tactical battles. Choose diplomacy or war. Build your economy, forge alliances and negotiate trade deals, then command your armies in battle. Outthink, outflank, outlast.

name: Nancy Drew®: Legend of the Crystal Skull
summary: The Search is on for an Unearthly Artifact in New Orleans!

name: Anomaly Company
summary: You and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game. Memorize the environment. Spot disturbing anomalies. Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over.

name: Swift Elf
summary: Swift Elf is a 2D platformer with adventure elements. In it you have to play as a clever elf who found himself in mysterious lands. Help him find a way out, destroy monsters and go through location after location collecting bonuses on his way!

name: Defend The Totem
summary: Defend The Totem is a fast paced tactical survival game where you will have to select the right combination of cards to defend the totem as long as you can. Every play is different and there are a lot of powerful builds to be discovered !

name: Mercenary Kings: Reloaded Edition
summary: Craft your arsenal to avenge your fallen comrades and save the world from the fearsome forces of CLAW!

name: River Secret
summary: A story about a beautiful river that hides deadly secrets beneath its calm surface.

name: Sudoku Mansion
summary: A story-driven Sudoku adventure by puzzle setter Nurator, featured on Cracking the Cryptic. Explore a mysterious mansion of handcrafted Sudoku variants, master increasingly intricate puzzles, and uncover the secret hidden beyond the grid.

name: Theoria: A God Simulator
summary: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

name: Indie Game: The Movie
summary: The emotional journey of four developers as they sacrifice money, health and sanity to realize their lifelong dreams of sharing their games with the world.

name: Conflict Area
summary: Conflict Area is both a singleplayer and multiplayer game made by 2 developers.

name: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
summary: A remake of the 2004 game METAL GEAR SOLID 3: SNAKE EATER, with the same gripping story and engrossing world, now with all new graphics and 3D audio that enhance the jungle atmosphere. Get ready for the ultimate survival stealth action experience.

name: TROPHY FLEET
summary: TROPHY FLEET is a top-down shoot 'em up where every boss you kill becomes your next ship. Fly an unbroken run from world to world, shoot out each core, and steal it. A full run is about an hour, and it never pauses.

name: Galactic Missile Defense
summary: Galactic Missile Defense is a shooter and tower defense game, where you must protect Earth from the invading Martians that declared war on our planet just because a space rover accidentally ruined their picnic!

name: Super Robot Wars 30
summary: 30 years on, the battle for our world's future continues. Super Robot Wars is a tactical RPG that brings characters and robots from a variety of mecha anime together to battle their mutual foes.

name: Freestyle 2: Street Basketball
summary: Freestyle 2: Street Basketball is a fast paced online arcade basketball game. Create your own unique player and compete in the online street league! Use variety of b-ball moves and customize your player! Team up with the best street ballers online and rise to the top!

name: Amatarasu Riddle Star
summary: Daily life meets fantastical fairy tales in this slice-of-life romance Visual Novel. Pursue one of five unique and quirky heroines in this funny, charming tale of wishes, dreams, and love.

name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
summary: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

name: Banana Shooter
summary: Dave is the banana man who is keep shooting enemies and get their banana,and use some cool mechanic such as dash,double jump,grapple hook and rocket jump.If you are finding fast paced shooter game,this is what you need

name: Poly Fighter
summary: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with beginner-friendly controls to master your moveset and claim your title!

name: Spy Fox in "Dry Cereal"
summary: The super-suave agent, SPY Fox, must find Mr. Udderly, rescue all the cows, and stop William the Kid from depleting the worlds supply of milk. Using ingenious SPY gadgets, keen wits, and daring moves, SPY Fox, jumps out on an udderly exhilarating adventure!

name: STAR WARS™ Empire at War - Gold Pack
summary: Command or corrupt an entire galaxy in the definitive Star Wars strategy collection. It is a time of galactic civil war. Will you take up the reins of the Rebellion, assume control of the Empire, or rule the Star Wars Underworld?

name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
summary: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

name: Restaurant Battle
summary: Challenge yourself as a novice restaurateur in the face of existing competition. Open your establishment, decorate it according to your taste, manage staff and control purchases. Do everything to become the best, using honest and not very ways!

name: Anime Shop Simulator ✨
summary: Manage your own anime shop 🎌. Play solo or team up with friends 🤝 in 4-player co-op mode to grow your business 📈 Stock shelves with manga, figures, and collectible cards in this immersive first-person game 🕹️.

name: Love Shore
summary: Play as Sam or Farah as they attempt to navigate the neon thrills of their cyberpunk city Love Shore, solve murders, fight gods and maybe fall in love.

name: Breath of Fire IV
summary: Master an array of skills and magic to unlock strategic victories in battle as you go head to head with unique enemies using powerful "Dragon Transformations" and combo actions! Follow the intertwining stories of Ryu and Fou-Lu to their thrilling conclusion in this classic RPG adventure.

name: Mars Base
summary: Welcome to Mars Base, humanity’s foothold on the Red Planet! Join the expedition as an interstellar botanist and make history: turn barren soil into fertile farmland, grow food for colonists’ tables, and unearth the secrets of Mars! Are you ready to science the “crop” out of everything?

name: iRacing® Studios NASCAR 26
summary: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26! Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase!

name: Mistwinter Bay
summary: Rule a town in this story heavy, visual novel-like fantasy RPG! Interact with townsfolk and foreign leaders, build and expand, and tackle randomized events that affect the town and its people.

name: Basketball Madness
