summary: Basketball Madness is a super fun VR sports and arcade game. Play and fight against the enemies that want to distract you from scoring. Basketball shooting has never been so hilarious and so challenging at the same time.

name: Swim Sacabambaspis!
summary: The ancient fish “Sacabambaspis” game! Easy to operate but difficult! Let's compete to see how far you can swim!

name: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition
summary: Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost.

name: Rebel Galaxy
summary: Rebel Galaxy is a swashbuckling space adventure, with action-packed combat, exploration, discovery, trade, and “negotiation” with the outlandish denizens at the edge of the known universe.

name: Platformer Paradise
summary: Avoid Obstacles to complete levels, use anything to your advantage, hiding behind walls, glass, even staying out of the view of Cannons will suffice towards your survival.

name: Bodybuilder Simulator CO-OP
summary: Bodybuilder Simulator CO-OP is a deep open-world game set on an isolated Italian island where sport is the foundation of life. Train, manage your diet and develop your character while competing in various sports disciplines. Every decision impacts your body and your story.

name: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike
summary: Dice Tavern is a roguelike deckbuilding game built around the classic rules of Farkle. Collect 35 unique dice, combine 43 Synergies and put your luck to the test in a candlelit medieval tavern. Use dice as your weapon and luck as your wager. This time, will you Roll Again or Take the Win?

name: Cloak & Dagger: Shadow Operations
summary: A short, single player, third person, tactical stealth action game set in the early 1990's meant to be finished in one sitting. Use the shadows, shoot out lights, stun enemies, and conceal yourself in the darkness through 5 Missions.

name: Laser Attraction
summary: Play with lasers and solve puzzles in Laser Attraction. Use reflection, refraction, dispersion and filtration to direct the laser beams, mix and separate colours, open doors, hit targets and complete puzzles.

name: Milki Delivery
summary: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside docks to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.

name: Sister Leticia: The First Mission!
summary: A monastery has mysteriously lost contact with the outside world. Leticia, a rookie nun is tasked to investigate, and she soon discovers that the village has been attacked by monsters. Will Leticia be able to make it home safely?

name: Chef Knight
summary: Cook what you kill in this cozy fantasy incremental game! Dive into dangerous dungeons, harvest fresh monster ingredients, and serve delicious dishes to hungry adventurers. Slay, cook, sell and upgrade your way to a sprawling dungeon-food empire!

name: Crystal of Atlan
summary: Crystal of Atlan is a Magicpunk MMO Action RPG where you can immerse yourself in a Magicpunk world. Build your skills, fight and uncover the secrets of this world with your allies! Time to embark on a wondrous journey of Magic and Machinery!

name: X-Plane 11
summary: The future of flight simulation is now! X-Plane 11 is the detailed, realistic, and modern simulator you’ve been waiting for. Intuitive user interface, 3-D cockpits, new effects, 3-D sound, living airports and world-wide scenery.

name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
summary: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

name: Drift Legends 2
summary: Arcade drifting with 50+ dream cars, from JDM icons to American Muscle. Master the art of the drift in a huge career, then dominate the competition in cross-platform online battles. Your legend begins now—no high-end PC required.

name: The Grotto Diary
summary: "The Grotto Diary " is a first-person Chinese-style horror game set against a native Chinese backdrop. The story is partially inspired by the works of Lu Xun. You will assume the role of the young girl Hua Xiaoxi lost between dreams and reality, in a story that may still hold hope.. Coming 2026.

name: Clay Soldiers
summary: The war rages on, choose to side with the Mercenaries, the Undead, the Angels, and more! Play through the single-player campaign, unifying the factions. Fight against other players and AI in the battleground's mode! Or strive for a conquest that takes you through the ages in war mode.

name: Echo Grotto
summary: Echo Grotto is a virtual reality experience that lets you explore unique and intricate cave systems using a range of caving gear and tools!

name: Devil Daggers
summary: Devil Daggers is a fast-paced shooter that places you in an abyssal arena to face endless legions of demons. Armed with versatile magic daggers and a fluid movement system, fight to survive as long as you can.

name: System Arrival
summary: Top-down co-op survival action RPG for 1–4 players in a world the System turned into a game. Earn levels, quests and psychic powers, scavenge the ruins, fight zombies and build an underground bunker for survivors — then find out what the System really wants.

name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
summary: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

name: Danganronpa Another Episode: Ultra Despair Girls
summary: Komaru Naegi has been imprisoned inside a mysterious apartment for over a year. Her rescue is derailed when hundreds of Monokumas suddenly attack. She teams up with Toko Fukawa to survive the rampaging Monokumas, escape the crafty Monokuma Kids, and uncover the secrets of the city.

name: Volcano Simulator - Reunion Island
summary: A unique and interactive lava simulator ! Interact in real-time with eruptions in photorealistic and dynamic environments. Create eruptions, control flow, pressure, temperature, and see the result in beautifully rendered 3D landscapes !

name: Demonologist
summary: Demonologist is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. Your goal is to identify the type of evil spirit in cursed places and exorcise it using your equipment, either alone or with your team.

name: Monster Trucks Nitro
summary: Race, jump and nitroboost your way pass thrilling dynamic levels with your monster trucks. Earn medals and unlock new levels and vehicles. Lots of brilliant tracks Be fast but use also your wits to pass the tracks Improve your times and earn medals Collect the Nitro tanks to unleash special powers! Unlock extra trucks!

name: Bombardiro Crocodilo: The Naked Clue
summary: A visual novel in the "noir story" genre, where the grit of Sin City meets the humor of The Naked Gun, the madness of Archer, and a dose of Italian brainrot!

name: Trucker Horror
summary: The main character is a truck driver. Along the way, he finds a road that is not on the map and drives along it. On the road, abandoned cars and abandoned gas stations are a place shrouded in horror, secrets and mysteries. Soon the hero realizes that someone is watching him...

name: Zone Nova
summary: Commandant, the world is in danger! Lead powerful Novas from ancient civilizations into the Forbidden Zones in this squad‑based RTS ARPG, battle monsters from the black spheres and seduce every maiden. Enjoy real‑time combat, idle growth, explosive battles and lewd fun all in one adventure.

name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
summary: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

name: Stolen Realm
summary: Stolen Realm is a simultaneous turn-based tactical dungeon crawling looter with action RPG elements where you control up to 6 heroes, solo or through online co-op, venturing forth in adventures set in a high-fantasy, low-poly world.

name: Crystal Project
summary: Crystal Project is a non-linear JRPG where you are the maker of your own adventure. Explore the world while you find Crystals, unlock classes, learn abilities, and create a strategy capable of taking down the world's toughest bosses. Or just stick to exploring; it's up to you.

name: Diamond Caves
summary: Diamond Caves is a classic arcade puzzle games related to the good old 8bit and 16bit days. Get out of a cave by collect all the Emeralds and Diamonds and beware of traps and monsters... now with level editor!

name: Dragon Creek
summary: Ever wanted your own dragon? Dragon Creek is a dragon raising game where every dragon is procedurally generated. Enter a code at the shrine and see your dragon come to life. Care for your dragon as you train it for battle and compete in tournaments!

name: Deep Blue Sushi
summary: Deep Blue Sushi is a casual 1–5 player co-op adventure where you explore the ocean, catch fresh fish, prepare sushi, serve customers, and grow your restaurant while uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Deep Blue.

name: Sackboy™: A Big Adventure
summary: PERFECTLY CRAFTED FOR PC. PlayStation® icon Sackboy bursts into action on PC in a huge 3D multiplayer platforming adventure. An epic journey stuffed with platforming challenges. Deeply immersive controls. Collaborative, chaotic and joyful multiplayer fun.

name: IRON REBELLION
summary: Climb into the cockpit of a 40-ton war machine. Built for VR, this mech simulator puts every switch, weapon, and system in your hands. Customize your mech, fight solo against bots, play offline, or face rival pilots in tactical 8v8 cross-platform combat.

name: Attack on Titan 2 - A.O.T.2
summary: Abandon all fear. Attack on Titan 2 is the gripping sequel to the action game based on the worldwide hit anime series "Attack on Titan."

name: Safari Cannon
summary: Explore the wilds of the African Safari and discover all the wild beasts of the savannah. From elephants to monkeys, you'll encounter a host of creatures who will try to stop you. It's a fun game for the whole family - so come on, join the adventure!

name: Wagotabi: A Japanese Journey
summary: Wagotabi is an educational RPG teaching Japanese from the ground up. Immerse yourself in the language through interactive dialogues, quest-solving, and puzzles, all while exploring Japan and its rich culture. Will you become a Japanese master?

name: Legend of Defenders
summary: A thrilling idle tower defense game with automated battles and endless growth, and enjoy a pure single-player experience with zero in-app purchases! Build your defenses, deploy heroes, and watch your fortress evolve from a humble outpost into an unstoppable stronghold—even while you’re away.

name: Omega Pilot
summary: Omega Pilot is an exciting first-person VR racing game with realistic physics and control mechanics. Compete for in-ring races with other pilots in asynchronous multiplayer and enjoy the view from the cockpit at high speed!

name: Cycling Champion
summary: A fast-paced tactical cycling game where every kilometer is a decision. Play your cards, manage your energy, time your attacks and fight for victory across Grand Tours, stage races and legendary Classics.

name: Dark Riddle
summary: Find out the scary secrets of the neighbor.

name: Synthwave Driver
summary: A nostalgic road trip on an endless highway, driving iconic '80s cars through a neon-filled paradise. Let the synthwave soundtrack guide you toward the horizon, leading you into a world of nostalgic vibes.

name: The Witches Pond
summary: The Witches Pond is a horror-adventure game based on the real-life place with the same name. Enter a world of mystery and strange places where you will experience events that may or may not seem real.

name: Red Chat Ritual  – TSUMIMI TIME
summary: “Intervene in Tsumimi’s stream” through comments and Mega Chats, then use your deductions to change their fate in this 15-day psychological horror adventure.

name: Mutant Alley
summary: Mutant Alley is a 2D and VR first person fantasy sex simulation and a complete remake of the original Mutant Alley - Do The Dinosaur.

name: Happy Wheels
summary: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

name: Vade Retro : Exorcist
summary: Vade Retro is a PvP exorcism game up to 4 player. Play as Demon and make your opponents go through hell, or join the exorcist team by choosing a specialty to save victims from the devil's grip in this action-packed experience.

name: Dimension Drive
summary: This intense space shoot ’em up challenges you to fight across two battlefields on one splitscreen. Instantly switch between them to dodge waves of bullets, reach secret areas, or surprise your enemies. Play solo or turn it up to 11 with a local co-op partner.

name: LEGO® Marvel™ Super Heroes
summary: LEGO® Marvel™ Super Heroes features an original story crossing the entire Marvel Universe. Players take control of Iron Man, Spider-Man, the Hulk, Captain America, Wolverine and many more Marvel characters as they unite to stop Loki and a host of other Marvel villains from assembling a super-weapon capable of destroying the world.

name: Trash Horror Collection
summary: Welcome to a true 80's trash horror experience. This collection has 10 short horror games that you can freely choose which one you want to play.

name: SAND LAND
summary: SAND LAND is an action RPG where you become the main character as Beelzebub, a Fiend Prince. Lead your company of heroic misfits and explore the legendary world of SAND LAND created by Akira Toriyama.

name: Havsala: Into the Soul Palace
summary: Havsala is an investigative puzzle game with rich storytelling full of historical references and mysticism. Search the room for the clues left behind by the previous reincarnations of a single soul, solve the puzzles and unravel the mystery.

name: Sins of a Solar Empire II
summary: Battle for galactic dominance in this real-time 4X strategy game with unrivaled scale! You’ll explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate through military force, diplomacy, trade, culture, influence, and other underhanded tactics.

name: Level Devil
summary: “Troll” is such a strong word for this 2D platformer with nearly 240 uniquely inventive levels. Don’t let screaming YouTubers convince you that this game is unfair. It’s fair. Sure, there are buzzsaws but they’re NICE buzzsaws. You will curse the guy who made Level Devil (Me😈) then ask for more.

name: The Mosquito Gang
summary: The ultimate party game! In The Mosquito Gang, team up to battle mutant mosquito swarms in co-op PvE or fight in chaotic asymmetric PvP. Outrageous weapons, wild powers, and nonstop laughter—bring the party to life!

name: TransOcean 2: Rivals
summary: In TransOcean 2: Rivals you face a new challenge as the boss of your own shipping line in both single-player and - for the first time - multiplayer mode: The international competition has gotten a lot tougher and the battle for the most lucrative contracts has only just begun.

name: Re: Award
summary: Corridor walking simulator. You can walk in the corridor. Rin and Scarlett came to Rin's grandfather's house in the country.

name: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS
summary: Shadow the Hedgehog is back with Classic and Modern Sonic in SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS, an all-new collection featuring two unique experiences!

name: ApocalypseHQ
summary: Lead a survivor headquarters after the zombie outbreak in this turn-based management strategy game, where each turn represents one day. Allocate scarce people and supplies, restore territories and infrastructure, and expand through research and high-risk external operations.

name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
summary: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

name: Last Train Home
summary: The Great War is over - the fight continues. Command a legion of soldiers, desperately trying to make their way home amidst the chaos of civil war. Lead them through the unforgiving wilderness onboard an armored train. Manage your crew and resources and try to survive.

name: Haiku, the Robot
summary: Delve into the depths of a mechanical world in this cute, adventure-exploration game. Explore and fight in a land full of corrupt robots and machinery. All while seeking answers to the mysteries around you.

name: Gears of War: E-Day
summary: Experience Emergence Day – the brutal origin story of one of gaming’s most acclaimed third-person shooter franchises.

name: Farming Camp
summary: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
summary: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

name: Crystal Crisis
summary: An all-star cast of heroes has gathered to test their mettle in this cute and chaotic new color-matching ONLINE combat game! Crystal Crisis is presented like a fighting game, but players attack by arranging falling crystals and clearing them from the screen. It’s the ultimate Online puzzle battle throwdown!

name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS
summary: The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

name: Paint the Town Red
summary: Paint the Town Red is a chaotic first person melee combat game set in different locations and time periods. The voxel-based enemies can be punched, bashed, kicked, stabbed and sliced completely dynamically using almost anything that isn't nailed down.

name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
summary: On RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.

name: SpellForce: Conquest of Eo
summary: On a journey to great magical might, explore and control the lands of Eo in this ever-changing turn-based strategy role-playing game. Field armies and heroes in tactical combat, finish hundreds of quests, and gather spells and artefacts to become the most powerful mage of all.

name: Sniper Dan
summary: Sniper Dan is a delightfully funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a sniper rifle to solve hundreds of low-stakes jobs across six packed locations, discover surprising secrets, snap hilarious photo ops, and unlock costumes, upgrades, office décor, collectables and more!

name: shapez 2 - Factory
summary: Dive into a factory-building game with the focus on just that – building huge space factories! Design sprawling multi-level factories and satisfying production lines without limits. Tackle progressively challenging automation goals at your own pace, without the threat of enemies.

name: Detective Grimoire
summary: Detective Grimoire has been called to investigate a murder. The owner of a small tourist attraction, seemingly killed by the mythical creature his attraction is based around... Explore the area, inspect the crime scene, grill suspects, solve puzzles, hunt for clues & uncover the secret of the swamp!

name: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight
summary: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

name: The Lilliput Workshop
summary: A sandbox logic puzzle game with a nostalgic temperament. You can experience the endless fun of designing automata here.

name: Minecraft Dungeons
summary: Fight your way through an exciting action-adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe!

name: F-117A Nighthawk Stealth Fighter 2.0
summary: Down below, the enemy sits unaware while a sleek, metallic creature slices through the dark. No blips show on the radar, no sign is given. Then, an instant, the roar of exploding ordnance shatters the night, demolishing targets, sending troops and pilots scrambling.

name: Supreme Commander
summary: For a thousand years, three opposing forces have waged war for what they believe is true. There can be no room for compromise: their way is the only way. Dubbed The Infinite War, this devastating conflict has taken its toll on a once-peaceful galaxy and has only served to deepen the hatred between the factions.

name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
summary: This is a fight for survival. Xenomorphs swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last.

name: Machine Party
summary: Machine Party — это коллекция суровых и беспощадных игр для вечеринки, где любая ошибка может стать роковой. Состязайтесь с друзьями не на жизнь, а на смерть. Пройдите жёсткие испытания и покажите, чего вы стоите. Шансы выжить минимальны.

name: Caravan SandWitch
summary: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure.

name: Rune Factory 4 Special
summary: Journey to the vibrant world of Rune Factory and experience the legendary fantasy farming adventure like never before!

name: Below the Stone
summary: Below the Stone is an extraction roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

name: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division
summary: Solve criminal cases through the power of SQL queries! Help out the city of Los Zorangeles by becoming a Database Detective in this new (unpaid) work from home opportunity.

name: Zombie Army 4: Dead War
summary: Hitler’s hordes are back for more in this spine-chilling shooter from the makers of Sniper Elite 4! Abominable occult enemies, epic weapons and a harrowing new campaign for 1-4 players await in 1940s Europe, as you fight to save humankind from undead Armageddon!

name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
summary: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

name: RemoteSpace: First Settlement
summary: A hard-sci-fi orbital settlement sim where you mine asteroids, build infrastructure, fight enemy, and operate inside a living solar system shaped by orbital mechanics, limited information, and long-distance logistics.

name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
summary: From the creators of Vampire Survivors comes a turbo-charged, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder! Deal world-ending combos, blitz through infested dungeons, and master the Turboturn to obliterate hordes of familiar foes with a chaotic hand of cards.

name: The Duck Pond
summary: The Duck Pond is a condensed and relaxing idle game, focused on creating a short handcrafted experience with an ending. Throw food to attract different types of duck, read about them in the duckopedia, and maybe you'll discover the epic giga duck!

name: Dimension Drifter
summary: You are one of the most dangerous people in the world. Our timeline has collapsed hundreds of years ago. Since then, Ancient Gods have emerged through the cracks of reality, shaping it into a twisted realm of chaos. You are the only one who can stop them. Get ready.

name: Rocket Wars
summary: Fast-paced local multi-player game packed with action. Destroy your friends with all sorts of different weapons and power-ups across multiple game modes!

name: Queen's Domain
summary: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

name: Metal Flame
summary: Metal Flame is an adult-only pixel 2D platform shooter game.

name: Snow Ash
summary: Snow Ash is a post-apocalyptic, wasteland-themed card-based trading and survival game. In this snow-covered world, you’ll take on the role of a messenger, braving blizzards to deliver goods between scattered shelters. In the biting cold and swirling snow, where will your journey lead?

name: Nitro Express
summary: Nitro Express is a 2D side-view gun action game where cute pixel-art girls shoot assault weapons with 360° free aiming in the streets of Japan!

name: Spy Drops
summary: Inspired by stealth action from the 90’s, undertake a series of covert ops to save the world from a global terrorist threat. Experience PS generation, 3D stealth action updated with modern effects, randomly generated levels, modern equipment, and head-to-head local multiplayer.

name: Le Mans Ultimate
summary: Step into the world of endurance racing and race on the official game of the FIA World Endurance Championship and 24 Hours of Le Mans. Race the latest Hypercars, LMGT3, LMP2 and GTE machinery on laser-scanned circuits with dynamic weather, ranked online competition, asynchronous Co-op and VR.

name: Assetto Corsa Rally
summary: Assetto Corsa Rally is a high-fidelity rally sim built for precision and challenge. With 3D laser-scanned stages and cars, professional co-driver support, and dynamic conditions, it delivers a demanding, immersive experience where every second behind the wheel counts.

name: Golf It!
summary: Embark on an exciting journey with Golf It! Seize your putter, rally your friends, and immerse yourself in an epic minigolf adventure. Conquer countless courses, create lasting memories, and refine your skills to emerge as the ultimate minigolf champion. Your thrilling golfing odyssey begins here!

name: Hyper Chess
summary: There are NO TURNS in this wild version of Chess! Pieces move across the board in real-time, so you'll need to think fast to protect your King!

name: Tenta Shooter
summary: Here comes a shoot-em-up game with a unique theme, tentacles! Defeat gigantic monster girls using a powerful bullet counter system!

name: HOT WHEELS™ Infinite Rush
summary: Jump into a Hot Wheels™-sized world with four islands packed with events, challenges and full-throttle mayhem. Collect iconic vehicles, assemble your Rush Squad, build epic tracks, and earn the title of Rush Master.

name: Mountain Trap 2: Under the Cloak of Fear
summary: In the exciting sequel to the Mountain Trap series, a trip to the mysterious town of Wilshere reveals that several young women have mysteriously disappeared. The local sheriff has lost all hope in solving the case, and residents are afraid to leave their homes for fear of the looming threat of abduction.

name: Potion Tycoon
summary: Potion Tycoon is a management simulator with a witchy twist! Build and develop your very own magic shop. Manage resources, set up production lines, mix potions and sell them smartly to stay ahead of the competition. Welcome to the potion business!

name: Crime Podcast: Welcome to the Neighborhood
summary: Jesse Turner, a 29-year-old employee of an insurance company, moves to a neighboring state after being assigned to a local branch. As he settles into his new place, he encounters unusual events that soon turn his life into a real nightmare.

name: Swamp Fellas
summary: Swamp Fellas is a cozy multiplayer game up to 8 players where frogs fish, vibe, and cause mild chaos. Explore a chill island, talk with friends via proximity chat with a reactive character, and mess around with weird props in a third space made for silly fun moments.

name: Idols of Ash
summary: Grapple, clamber and fall thousands of meters down into a dark and ancient place in this first-person horror climbing game. You are being hunted.

name: Tennis Manager 26
summary: Step into the most advanced tennis management experience ever. Run your academy, develop top talent, upgrade your staff and facilities, and dominate the junior and pro circuits. A new chapter begins, are you ready to take control?

name: Golf Gang
summary: Golf Gang is a racing game. It’s a party game. It’s the fastest game of minigolf you'll ever play! Blend precision with speed to dominate in 8-player online mayhem or your solo speed runs.

name: Rifle Strike
summary: Scorestreaks, Weapons, Progression System, All for free! A First-Person shooter oriented towards fast-paced gameplay.

name: Gold Gold Adventure Gold
summary: In this world, it’s all about the gold! Use it to build up a fantasy town, recruit heroes, give quests, raise a Godbeast, cast powerful spells, and expand your influence—all one gold coin at a time.

name: Mr.Mine
summary: Explore the depths of the earth and uncover hidden treasures in this addictive idle mining game. Unlock the power of your drill with hundreds of upgrades, discover mysterious relics, and unearth priceless gems. Can you master the mines and reveal their deepest secrets? Dive in and dig deep!

name: Sniper Elite 3
summary: Sniper Elite 3 is a tactical third-person shooter that combines stealth, gameplay choice and genre-defining ballistics with huge, open levels and the exotic terrain of World War 2 North Africa.

name: The Last Flame
summary: Recruit a party of unique heroes, fight deadly encounters, loot and craft powerful gear, discover and create thousands of synergetic builds! The Last Flame is an endless roguelike auto-battler in which you guide a righteous party of heroes through many challenges.

name: The Silver Case
summary: The Silver Case – the debut title from world-renowned developer SUDA51 has been fully remastered and localized to English for the first time ever!

name: Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX
summary: Become the coach of a prestigious sports academy's tennis club, filled with stunning girls who all dislike you. How will you handle it? Win them over, of course! Prepare for intense tennis matches with dynamic gameplay and powerful abilities. Prove your skills and earn their bodies.

name: How Empires Work
summary: An incremental grand strategy game about building the machinery of empire. Tax, trade, conquer, and civilise subjects and foreigners alike. Automate it all into institutions that run themselves across centuries of history. Her Imperial Majesty expects results.

name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
creators: 上海アリス幻樂団 / 上海アリスReprise
summary: Dodge the barrage, defeat the enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist Incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics. Control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, weaving between bullets that fill up the screen. The soundtrack has been fully remade by ZUN.

name: Fly Caster - VR Fly Fishing
summary: Fly fishing is not like ordinary fishing. Learning to cast a fly is a sport all on it's own. It's challenging, it's rewarding and it's a thing of beauty when done well. Once you've mastered fly fishing there's no going back.

name: Zombie Shooter 2
summary: Just choose a character to the liking, get experience to develop skills, earn money and spend it at weapons, medications and useful devices. All of this will be used against thousands of enemies. The zombies fill the game screen, never letting you rest, even for a minute.

name: Chef Life: A Restaurant Simulator
summary: Create and manage your dream restaurant! Menus, purchasing, décor, staff, equipment, customers… and don't forget the actual cooking! Experience the daily life of a restaurateur and earn your awards from the Michelin Guide.

name: BoneTown: The Second Coming Edition
summary: GTA meets South Park with sex and drugs in BoneTown, a hilariously hardcore game that combines free roaming, action adventure gameplay with fucking, fighting, and getting fucked up.

name: Fishing Planet
summary: Fishing Planet® is a highly realistic first-person online multiplayer fishing simulator. Developed by avid fishing enthusiasts to bring you the full thrill of actual angling on your PC. Free-to-Play and just a download away!

name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 6
summary: Live the future of despair.The year is 2024 AD. The survivors fought against the remaining threats while trying their best to continue their recovery.Three years passed in the year 2027. In a new world without hope, the time has come to once again resist the fate of the Earth.

name: The Emerald Tablet
summary: Enter the world of alchemy in the daily adventures of the money-hungry but good intentioned Misty, the arrogant adventure-seeking Gladys, and the explosive "expert" Winifred.

name: Kemonomimi Territory
summary: There’s only room for one kemonomimi tribe on the island. Recruit your army, claim hexes and capture rival bases to be the last tribe standing. Play this single-player, turn-based virtual board game in VR or on desktop.

name: of the Devil
summary: Immerse yourself in neon, smoke, and high-stakes legal gambles as a Defense Attorney with uniquely Killer insights in this episodic, diabolically stylish visual novel adventure game.

name: Skull and Bones
summary: Skull and Bones is an open world naval action RPG where ship combat, build choice, and sailing skill define your pirate legend. Conquer rival ships and mythical beasts in a vast ocean of up to 20 players.

name: Solar System Simulator
summary: Gravity and exploration sandbox

name: Micro Platformer
summary: A minimalistic platformer with a 1x1 tileset. No enemies, no bullets, no lasers. Just sheer platforming.

name: 1-2-Swift
summary: “1-2-Swift: It’s high noon” is a party game for 2 players but using only 1 set of HTC Vive or just keyboard! Duel your friend as a cowboy and shoot the bullet as soon as “High Noon” come!

name: Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate
summary: Chess, but you replace your entire army with a royal shotgun. A unique strategy roguelike based on the timeless checkboard classic.

name: Q - A Neon Platformer
summary: Jump into a neon-filled platformer world as Q and overcome a gauntlet of tricky platform challenges.

name: Nova Drift
summary: Nova Drift distills the mechanical depth and strategy of an ARPG into classic arcade space combat. Control an endlessly evolving bio-mechanical ship, face legions of strange and deadly foes, and ride the wake of a dying star across the void.

name: Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together
summary: Cook, create, and run your dream restaurant. Master realistic cooking mechanics, invent original recipes, satisfy demanding guests, and build your culinary reputation. Play solo or team up with friends in optional co-op. Become the Chef Everyone Talks About!

name: Cloud Climber
summary: A surreal first person walking sim about the end of humanity. Explore magnificent sky-bound ruins, and learn why they were built.

name: iRacing
summary: We are the world’s premier motorsports racing game. An iRacing membership provides entry into the newest form of motorsport: internet racing. Internet racing is a fun, easy, and inexpensive way for race fan and gamers alike to enjoy the thrill of the racetrack from the comfort of their home.

name: Tunnel VR
summary: Like racing trough endless tunnels in space? Then look no further, this is the game for you. Because it is all about racing. In a tunnel. In space.

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection
summary: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection contains thirteen prior released classic games. This collection is a great place for gamers to experience these popular titles on Steam.

name: Rocket Engineer
summary: Design custom rockets and master 2D orbital mechanics to navigate a fully simulated solar system. Establish outposts, process local resources to launch interplanetary missions, and manage critical supply lines to keep your colony's workforce alive.

name: Bomb Bowling 2
summary: Bomb Bowling 2 is an indie puzzle game with physics. Kick the pins out of the screen using explosions!

name: Combat Mission Fortress Italy
summary: Combat Mission Fortress Italy brings wargamers to the "soft underbelly of Europe", a place that was anything but.

name: Unclean Water
summary: Unclean Water is an FPS roguelike action game where you must escape the sewers of Marlene. Defeat Night Moss assassins using precise strikes, defense, smashes, and shield bashes to exploit enemy openings. Unlock a variety of furniture and items to turn your endless challenges into ultimate success.

name: Your Android
summary: Your life is changed forever when a mysterious package arrives at your front door. Go on many different outings with your new android companion as you both form unforgettable memories in this beautiful visual novel.

name: F-19 Stealth Fighter
summary: F-19 STEALTH FIGHTER takes combat flying to new heights. With dazzling graphics and authentic, real-world scenarios. F-19 creates action-packed excitement that keeps you coming back for more! It's easy to learn, but satisfyingly tough to master.

name: Dungeons of Clay
summary: Explore the ever-changing dungeons in the surreal world made of clay. Unlock the hidden secrets, overcome the dangers, defeat dreadful creatures and reap the treasures to acquire almighty power.

name: The Cave Diver
summary: A brutally challenging physics-horror caving game. Using only your hands, drag yourself down a suffocating cave system where every hold pulls you further into the darkness. Equal parts rage-game, claustrophobic nightmare, and descent into a forgotten folktale...

name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
summary: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

name: Prison Simulator
summary: Get a taste of prison life! Become a prison guard and deal with dangerous convicts. Prison management, lots of daily activities. Will you become the best guard in history? Or maybe you'll turn into the worst scumbag this Prison has ever seen?

name: Love or Lust Beach Stories
summary: Tropical paradise where every cocktail you mix shapes your fate. Build relationships and choose between love and lust in a next-gen adult visual novel with stunning 3D visuals and choice-driven gameplay.

name: DIVINE CRAFTING WORKSHOP
summary: Ancient China handcraft sim with shadow puppet art & multiple endings. As a craftsman, take orders, craft works, unlock dynasty stories. Full version: 7 dynasties, 28 categories, 110+ collectible handicrafts, 300+ event/40+ main endings, 50+ panda events & letters—immerse in traditional crafts.

name: Super Gloves Hero
summary: Can you save the Shubby planet from the most dangerous pirate spaceship?

name: Human Fast Food
summary: A cooking simulator where you run an underground fast food for monsters and serve them with human meat. Improve your kitchen appliances, unlock new recipes, manage your stock and keep the monsters well fed.

name: Tunnel Rats
summary: Tunnel Rats is a dark and intense single-player shooter for PC that depicts the horrific realities of the Vietnam War as seen through the eyes of a young US soldier. As member of a “Tunnel Rats” squad, the player is trained to clearing out the huge tunnel systems underneath the jungle of Vietnam.

name: The Smoke
summary: The Smoke is a 2D Metroidvania where players wield a gun to disperse the smoke that threatens to engulf the world. Explore a world filled with hidden pathways and treacherous chambers. Blast away enemies, clear toxic clouds, and unlock new abilities. Stop the darkness before it swallows everything.

name: Goodbye Volcano High
summary: Goodbye Volcano High is a cinematic narrative adventure about love, change, and the end of the world. Guide Fang through their final year of high school as they try to make things right before time is up.

name: Hex of Steel
summary: Hex of Steel is a refreshing WWII wargame covering all fronts featuring a certain amount of original mechanics. Fight in solo against finally a decent AI throughout Europe, Africa or the Pacific, or against a friend in the cross-platform PBEM or real time multiplayer. Coop is also an option!

name: Fly'N
summary: Somewhere between a platformer, a puzzle game and a great big dollop of pure fun, Fly’N will challenge your skills through more than forty levels set in a luxuriant world. Experiment with the four Buds to save the World-Trees from Dyer, the loony hair-dryer who intends to destroy their Helys!

name: Iron Blight
summary: Iron Blight is a survival horror game set in a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town. You are trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows, and above all, find your wife, Valeria.

name: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4
summary: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 is the latest evolution of PIRATE WARRIORS action! Based on the concept of "experiencing a real ONE PIECE battlefield," buildings will come crashing down during the action and attacks will throw up smoke and dust, placing you in the thick of the ONE PIECE world!

name: Paradise Marsh
summary: Stars vanished from the sky and scattered across a perfect endless wetland... Catch bugs and chat with many characters while playfully wandering through peaceful scenery. But don't lose sight of the night sky, the constellations need help!

name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
summary: Returning to an island town to ‘put things right’, Simon Ordell descends into a world of tense evasion, explosive confrontations, and mind-bending puzzles that slowly surface the truth of St. Amelia.

name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II
summary: This game is a brand-new entry in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series, the first installment of which was initially released in 2018 and sold over 3 million copies worldwide.

name: Room 404: Erotic Massage
creators: シン・ギュラリティー
summary: After a long, busy day, the girls’ bodies are tense and tight. From their tiptoes to heads, help them fully relax. Gently knead their sensitive areas, apply massage oil to make their skin smooth and glistening. They can release the desires of body and soul through an erotic massage......

name: Cyber Bay
summary: "Cyber Bay" is a 2D rhythm action roguelike in which the player takes on the role of the last surviving human fighting against a zombie apocalypse caused by artificial intelligence. The player's main objective is to survive, fight zombies, and find ways to destroy the AI.

name: Forever Tunnel
summary: Lead your squad through a destabilizing reality in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Defeat enemies. Contain corruption. Prevent collapse.

name: Jack Axe
summary: Be Jack! Get an axe! Take Jack (and her sisters) on an axe tossing, single or multiplayer, platforming adventure in a vibrant open world inspired by Filipino and Norse mythology.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
summary: Enter the abandoned workshop of Murray’s Costume Manor and unravel the mystery left behind by the reclusive inventor. In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, you’ll step into a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every flicker of light hints at an ever-present threat.

name: Cave Crawler
summary: Cave Crawler is a short horror game where you pilot a drone into a cave and discover something horrible.

name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State
summary: A horror-infused extraction shooter for squads of three. Crush monster hordes with devastating firepower in co-op PvE, or take on rival squads for The Vertex in PvP. Choose your battle, push as far as you dare, and make it out alive.

name: Ocean Survivors
summary: Dominate the ocean! Sink enemy ships, loot their wrecks for gold, weave through a storm of cannonballs, and expand your arsenal. Level up unique builds, unlock abilities, and survive relentless attacks. Upgrade your ship and become the ultimate pirate!

name: Zoom Player : Steam Edition
summary: Est. in 1999, Zoom Player provides the most impactful media player and Home Theater experience for Windows. Beautiful skins, many UI/UX tweaking options, smooth playback, plays all the format (including streaming options such as YouTube), a powerful media library and much more, check it out!

name: Bone Appetit
summary: When the king declares that all food is now his, whatcha' gonna' do? Raise a skeleton slave to steal it back for you, of course!

name: COP BASTARD
summary: COP BASTARD is a classic FPS set in early ’90s Japan. Play as a tough detective and blast through waves of yakuza in relentless action inspired by ’90s films. No puzzles, perks or upgrades - just corridors, enemies and the chance to spit in their faces.

name: Workshop Simulator VR
summary: Workshop Simulator VR is a simulation game where you take on the role of a workshop owner, equipped with a range of specialized tools. Become a master of restoring various items!

name: Basketball Classics
summary: 5 on 5 Pro Basketball born from the golden era of sports games. This spiritual successor to the 8-bit ballers bridges the gap between retro and today’s simulation games. Side-scrolling, sweaty arcade action with simplified 3-button gameplay and retro vibes galore.

name: Summer~Life in the Countryside~
summary: An simulation game about reuniting with your childhood friend,and spending your summer vacation having her.

name: Quick Square
summary: Quick Square is a bright hardcore puzzle platformer.

name: Gulf of Aden - Task Force Somalia
summary: In 20 different missions you have to tactically prevent pirates in the Gulf of Aden from attacking and seizing civilian targets. These targets range from oil tankers and drilling platforms to sailing yachts and even disabled pirate mother ships.

name: Dying Light: The Beast
summary: BECOME THE BEAST. SURVIVE THE NIGHT. A terrifying new chapter in the Dying Light universe begins. As Kyle Crane, explore the vast and unpredictable wilderness, uncover a deadly evolution of the infected, and learn to control the beastly powers awakening inside you.

name: Rocket Science
summary: Take part in a space program. Design spacecrafts and send them off to explore the vast expanses of space. Experience the real scale of the Solar system and the size of its celestial bodies.

name: Building our Futature
summary: Building our Futature is a futa NTR game where the player can choose what content they would like to see in the next in-game week. This way you can decide what type of scenes you'd like to avoid or what content to focus on.

name: Red Bow: Strange Dream
summary: Embark on an immersive adventure alongside Roh as she tries to break free from her strange dream.

name: Football Agent
summary: You're not the manager, you're the agent. Scout hidden gems across 47,500 players, win them over face to face, build their careers, and sell them for millions. A deep football agency career sim where every contract has your name on it.

name: Country Discoverer
summary: Test your reflexes and your intellect as you sail the seas discovering new countries by launching giant telescopes at them as they hurtle towards you.

name: Pirate Pop™
summary: You awaken on a strange island sometime in the afternoon. Half your face is sunburnt and seagulls stole your lunch. Enough about you. This is about Pete Jr! The tiny pirate! He looks up to see bubbles, tons of them! What's causing these bubbles to appear? Who is behind this awful mischief?

name: Slaughter Cannon
summary: Slaughter Cannon is an addictive physics puzzle game with exciting and challenging levels of varying difficulty.

name: Tactical Warfare
summary: The enemy attack on your base is imminent; secure your defenses, mobilize your troops, reinforce key positions, and get ready for the next battle. RTS Tactical Warfare will test your resilience and strategic prowess.

name: Evochron Mercenary
summary: The life of an independent mercenary is rarely without excitement. Your spacecraft awaits and your adventure begins in the Sapphire star system.

name: SAS: Zombie Assault 4
summary: Purge the undead! Intense action-shooter with deep rpg elements, including upgradeable guns and armor, unique class skills, and class special abilities. Entire game can be played single player or as a 4-player online co-op game, including PvP events like Last Man Standing.

name: Keyboard Chaos
summary: 2,692 keycaps. 32 keyboards. One messy desk. Find the right keycaps, match them to their positions, and complete every keyboard, square or round. Search, organize, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning chaos into perfectly assembled keyboards.

name: Catfish Idle Pond
summary: A charming and stylized idle desktop fishing game where your feline friend takes the spotlight. Unlock upgrades, maintain a detailed fish log, and personalize your island with delightful cosmetics to make it truly your own.

name: Runix: Pinball Roguelike
summary: A roguelike 3D pinball game where you build your ball deck to hit and slay monsters with incredible combos and climb to the top of the leaderboard. Discover powerful artifacts that create incredible synergies and increase your mage powers to restore "The Pinball Order"

name: Violent Horror Stories 2
creators: Trioskaz / thesecondleft / Garage Heathen / Alex Grim / INDIEPUNK / Bober Bros / myceliumforest / UniOwl / CapyDev / Anifan Gelati
summary: A brand‑new bundle from the creators of the short‑form horror hit Violent Horror Stories. This time the collection revolves around one chilling theme: confinement.

name: Hotel Hideaway: Avatar & Chat
summary: An immersive 3D social simulation MMO where you customize your avatar, build and decorate rooms, collect rare items, and join live community events in a nostalgic yet ever-evolving virtual world.

name: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 4
summary: The latest opus in the acclaimed STORM series is taking you on a colourful and breathtaking ride. Take advantage of the totally revamped battle system and prepare to dive into the most epic fights you’ve ever seen !

name: VESSELS: Noiret Mansion
summary: A retro-inspired PSX survival horror game set in the mysterious Noiret Mansion. Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, uncover the fate of the Noiret family, and survive the horrors lurking within its walls.

name: Mandate Order
summary: Mandate Order is a Warring States war city-builder set in ancient China. Build a stronghold, manage industries and logistics, recruit scholars from the Hundred Schools of Thought, raise armies, and command real-time tactical battles with thousands of soldiers.

name: Jigsaw Puzzle Dreams
summary: Beautiful Multiplayer Jigsaw Puzzle game where you can design the room you play in!

name: Metal: Hellsinger
summary: Slay to the rhythm of metal and vengeance on an infernal journey through the eight Hells. Make them fear the beat. Metal: Hellsinger is a rhythm FPS bursting with demons, badass weapons, and heavy metal music.

name: The Grotto Index
summary: A cozy nonogram (picross) adventure. Descend a living dungeon and fill a naturalist's journal one picture-logic puzzle at a time. 100 hand-crafted specimens across 10 floors. No fail states, no guessing: every puzzle is solvable by pure logic. Just you, a lantern, and quiet discovery.

name: DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA
summary: DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA is Dragon Ball's first team-oriented free to play game.

name: Angel Investor Simulator™
summary: Invest into promising startups with sometimes wacky ideas. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.

name: SHUTEN ORDER
summary: "168 remaining until the end of the world..." Humanity is approaching its end. A sudden dismemberment murder of the leader of a religious nation that advocates an apocalyptic ideology... Five adventure games are combined into one, centered around a suspenseful story full of mystery and intrigue.

name: Abyssal Lapidary
summary: A gothic management sim set in a Victorian-inspired underground metropolis. Appraise raw ores, cut exquisite gems, and craft unique jewelry for strange clients. Some stones are worth a fortune. Others stare back.

name: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective
summary: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective, the classic puzzle-solving mystery adventure directed by Ace Attorney creator Shu Takumi, is back! This long-awaited HD remaster features upgraded visuals and sound and new gallery content.

name: Grandpa High on Retro
summary: Grandpa goes on a third person, action adventure killing rampage, with his grandson after his smoking session was interrupted by a phone call.

name: Walkabout Mini Golf VR
summary: Escape into a fun and beautiful world filled with the best mini golf courses you’ve ever seen! Play by yourself, meet someone new, or challenge your friends in a private game with up to 8 people. Extremely realistic physics create the perfect experience for hardcore golfers and casual players alike.

name: Karryn's Prison
summary: Control the confident, sexy Karryn as she becomes the new Chief Warden in the notorious all-male prison in this RPG. Go manage the prison and its inmates, but can you also manage Karryn's ever rising desires? Experience the true adult game that fully marries adult elements into all gameplay!

name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt
creators: Wild Shadow Studios / Deca Live Operations GmbH
summary: Embark on an exhilarating journey into the pixelated Realm of the Mad God! Join, an action-packed, free-to-play MMO bullet hell game. Discover a world with danger, challenges, and hidden treasures as you battle through waves of enemies. Team up with players and conquer dungeons to become a legend!

name: Lover's Trophy
summary: A Horror Dating Sim, Lover's trophy throws you into the arena with two love interests using you for their own personal amusement. With a completely customizable main character, go on a terrifying journey into the psyce of these two very dangerous men, and have the ride of a life time.

name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

name: Empty The Lake!
summary: Empty the lake, make money, and discover what’s hidden at the bottom! Pump out thousands of liters of water, upgrade your tools, and keep going deeper to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

name: Ruby Hunter
summary: Collecting the gems in the mine will only sound easy until you try it! Solve the puzzles with the help of the game's unique mechanics, and fight your way towards the exit. Design levels using the included editor and share them with the community!

name: Under Par Golf Architect
summary: Step into the shoes of a golf architect as you build and manage your own golfing paradise! Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.

name: Fuck the Ocean
summary: One wet sock. A wildly unreasonable response. Fill puddles, lakes and entire oceans with sand, garden gnomes and increasingly ridiculous machinery in this simple, funny incremental game.

name: Bow-wow Battle
summary: Be a dog. Bark. And win. "Bow-wow Battle" is a 1v1 game where you bark into your mic for real! Steam Online Multiplayer supported! Push the tug-of-war gauge with voice volume and rapid-fire barks! Adorable dogs, Dog Road story mode, and Crab Survival. With friends, family, or your crush — bark out!

name: Hop Step Sing! kiss×kiss×kiss (HQ Edition)
summary: Another VIP ticket to Japan's newest idol group, Hop Step Sing!, is yours for the taking! Niina, Mikasa and Shikiri are back with their second single: "kiss×kiss×kiss", a melodious love song to follow their debut; "Kisekiteki Shining!".

name: Water Delivery
summary: Water Delivery is a first person, horror experience where you play as a water delivery boy. Ride along in the delivery truck from house to house. Deliver filled water jugs, find and return empty jugs, and collect all the payments. Will you be able to finish your final route of the evening?

name: Dungeon Defenders
summary: Create a hero from one of four classes to save Etheria in this 4-player coop Tower Defense Action-RPG. Includes Steam exclusive Portal gun & TF2 familiars!

name: Supply Chain Idle
summary: Build, link and upgrade factories to produce and sell products.

name: Old School Rally
summary: A nostalgic racing game that combines the charm of classic retro style visuals with the thrill of international rally competitions.

name: Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis
summary: Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis is a free-to-play action MMO. Join players around the world to explore the planet Halpha and fight in epic battles as ARKS Defenders! Unleash your imagination with our ultimate character creation experience and creative spaces to create your own phantasy.

name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
summary: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

name: Dorothy's Job
summary: A frenetic and hilarious isometric twin-stick shooter where you play as Dorothy, a muscular maid who is in charge of cleaning levels full of enemies and filth with deadly mops, vacuums, and outrageous cleaning tools.

name: Red Soil
summary: Survive the heat and the undead in this isometric horror game set in the Australian outback. Manage stamina, hydration, hunger, and fatigue while exploring random maps, leveling up, crafting gear, and to fight in the heat of the day or the darkness of night.

name: Character House -Desktop Companion-
summary: Character House: Desktop Companion is an idle collection game. Mix and match parts to create a companion that sits with you as you work, syncing with keystrokes, or watches from a corner. Earn rewards offline: pull and craft accessories,, shape its personality, and visit friends online!

name: MineMogul
summary: Design and build a factory deep underground in this physics-based automation sandbox. Mine resources, buy machines and master the chaos as you become the ultimate Mine Mogul!

name: Unsorted Horror
summary: A collection of 5 short first-person horror games, that revolve around detailed machinery and dread.

name: Assault Spy
summary: Dash, evade, and smash your way to the truth as the corporate spy, Asaru; or the reckless CIA agent, Amelia! Uncover the dark secrets of the Negabot mega corporation as you save the company from a hostile takeover. Assault Spy is a stylish, fast paced, pure-action game with a dash of comedy.

name: Night Shift Hospital
summary: A chaotic co-op job sim for up to 4 players about night-shift doctors. Handle a bizarre stream of patients, diagnose illnesses, and assign people to the correct treatment zones. Work as a team, get through nightly crises, and try your best not to get fired!

name: Backrooms: Escape Together
summary: A visually lifelike co-op horror game for 1-6 people. Journey through 11 procedurally generated levels, using what's available to survive and progress deeper into the Backrooms.

name: Train Sim World® 7
summary: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

name: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
summary: "Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

name: Tennis Elbow 4
summary: Created by and for tennis fans, Tennis Elbow 4 is a true tennis simulation built around anticipation, positioning and risk management. Easy to start, demanding to master, it delivers exceptional gameplay depth and long-term progression.

name: Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion: HD Renovation
summary: Can you survive 1000 rooms of cute terror? Or will you break once the cuteness starts to fade off and you're running for your life from the unspeakable hideous beings that shake and writhe in bowels of this house? They wait for you, they wait and hunger for meeting you.

name: War Wind
summary: War Wind is a real-time strategy game that allows you to view an epic battle through the eyes of four unique races, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. The game features 28 ready-to-play scenarios and a story of such compelling depth you won't believe it's just a game.

name: Rapid Escalation
summary: A fast-paced incremental space shooter where short battles fuel permanent upgrades and exponential growth.

name: The Karters 2: Turbo Charged
summary: Get ready for the ultimate kart racing experience on Steam & Steam Deck! Inspired by Crash Team Racing, built with its own identity, advanced gameplay systems, tons of new features and massive modding support for endless replayability!

name: Sandustry
summary: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

name: Pizza Tower
summary: Pizza Tower is a fast paced 2D platformer, with an emphasis on movement, exploration and score attack. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the cartoons from the '90s, and a highly energetic soundtrack.

name: Jump Space
summary: Jump Space (formerly Jump Ship) is a mission based co-op PvE for 1-4 players, where you are the crew of a spaceship. Transition seamlessly from crewing the ship to on-foot exploration and space walks. Explore, upgrade, and survive intense encounters in deep space together.

name: BOOK OF HOURS
summary: Restore a crumbling occult library by a winter sea. Build the world’s foremost collection of grimoires and arcana. Master the invisible arts. BOOK OF HOURS is a narrative crafting RPG set in a 1930s world of hidden gods and secret histories. What sort of Librarian will you choose to be?

name: Gillbert: Guardian of the Grotto
summary: Gillbert: Guardian of the Grotto is an adventure platformer set in a collapsing water world, dominated by the evil Broctopus and his bootlickers. Play as Gillbert who uses water to harness power against his enemies.

name: Industry Giant 2
summary: Economic booms, stock market crashes, oil crises, upswings, triumphs... Now you can become the greatest power in industry!

name: Grotto
summary: Grotto is a mystical, narrative-focused experience. You are the Soothsayer. The one capable of talking with the stars and unveiling their messages. In a time of turmoil, the tribe of the valley turn to your powers of divination and come to you for guidance.

name: Dark Flame
summary: Being a Dark Flame, the flame goes out quickly, you will have little time to find your way out, be smart or learn fast!

name: Fly Corp
summary: Develop your own transport network in different regions and cities: open new routes, buy and upgrade new planes, and increase airport capacity!

name: The Sinking City Remastered
summary: Powered by Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City Remastered brings the eerie, atmospheric world of Oakmont back to life with enhanced gameplay and fully relit environments, perfect for both newcomers and returning players.

name: Tennis Manager 2023
summary: Immerse yourself in the ultimate tennis simulation, where your decisions both on and off the court will shape the destiny of your academy. Be the number 1 manager and become a national Team Captain to lead your team to greatness. Serve your colors and win the World Cup of Tennis!

name: Einsteins Riddle
summary: A pure, simple game of logic and deduction. Random generated puzzles enables unlimited replay. Custom board layouts let you adjust the difficulty and time needed to solve a puzzle.

name: The Cursed Amulet
summary: Enter a mysterious cave and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test. Explore the depths of the cave, search for clues, and solve challenging puzzles that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

name: Tiny Bookshop
summary: Leave everything behind and open a tiny bookshop by the sea in this cozy narrative management game. Stock your tiny bookshop with different books and items, set up shop in scenic locations, and run your cozy second-hand bookshop while getting to know the locals.

name: Artemis Cosmos
summary: Cosmos simulates a spaceship bridge of up to six players, guarding your deep space stations against the menacing Kraliens and Torgoth. Immerse yourself in a modern space game with enhanced graphics and endless customization possibilities, guaranteeing countless hours of exhilarating fun.

name: Fly Fly Dragon!
summary: Embark on an epic adventure as a mighty dragon in "Fly Fly Dragon!"

name: JDM: Ph4ntom Driver
summary: Defeat the Demon King and save the Spirit World from Corruption in this action, racing, supernatural spin-off of JDM: Japanese Drift Master! Drive your JDM ride like a lethal weapon, drift through the corrupted open world, and smash hordes of Youkai as the Hero wielding the power of Destruction.

name: Mercenary Brotherhood
summary: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company, survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

name: Sand to Soil
summary: Turn this desert planet into a lush green habitat! Find seeds, manage water, and improve the soil levels. Sadly, you were sent on this mission with woefully insufficient equipment, so you will have to harness the most potent resource on the planet: a flowery species of sheep, and their poop.

name: Sakura Beach
summary: From the makers of Sakura Spirit, Sakura Angels and Sakura Fantasy this time working together with the artist Inma to bring you this visual novel dating sim on the beach! Seiji is a daydreamer who spends too much time thinking about space.

name: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT
summary: Dive into the legends of the Far East in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT; team up with friends in fast-paced melee fights for a Battle Royale experience unlike any other. Find your playstyle with a varied cast of heroes with unique skills. More than 40 million players have already joined the fray, play free now!

name: Mafia: The Old Country
summary: Uncover the origins of organized crime in Mafia: The Old Country, a gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily. Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Family in this immersive third-person action-adventure.

name: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2
summary: Destroy demons with the power of forged bonds! Tanjiro Kamado's battle will once again unfold…

name: Bendy and the Ink Machine
summary: Bendy and the Ink Machine® is the first person puzzle action horror game that will forever ruin your childhood love of cartoons.

name: Myth of Empires: Throne
summary: Myth of Empires: Throne is a free seasonal multiplayer warfare sandbox. Explore vast lands inspired by multiple civilizations, tame creatures, forge powerful weapons, and build your guild. Lead cross-server expeditions, conquer territories, and compete with players worldwide for the ultimate throne!

name: ZOOM
summary: ZOOM is a fast-paced silly FPS with strategic gun and skill swapping. Play as an FBI (Feeding Beasts Intelligence) Agent and navigate zoo exhibits to satiate the hunger of the animals and stop their angry uprising with your special food gun!

name: BONELAB
summary: BONELAB is an experimental physics action game. Explore a mysterious lab filled with weapons, enemies, challenges and secrets. Escape your reality, or wreak havoc. No wrong answers.

name: Order of the Sinking Star
summary: Order of the Sinking Star est une aventure narrative par Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness) dans un royaume rempli de magie et d'énigmes. Résolvez plus de 1000 casse-têtes interconnectés et faits main, découvrez des héros uniques, maîtrisez des mécaniques évolutives et percez un grand mystère.

name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
summary: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

name: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror
summary: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror is a J-horror RPG where events unfold in real-time. Survive one night in a city where every choice you make impacts the world around you. How many deaths will you be responsible for tonight?

name: Escape From Duckov
summary: Escape from Duckov is a PVE indie survival RPG — in a duck's world!. Scavenge for resources, build your hideout, and upgrade your gear in the world of Duckov. Start from nothing and rise to the top. Outwit hostile ducks, survive, or make it out alive.

name: Where Winds Meet
summary: Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.

name: Phantom Blade Zero
summary: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

name: VA-11 Hall-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action
summary: VA-11 HALL-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action is a booze em' up about waifus, technology, and post-dystopia life.

name: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand
summary: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand delivers a standalone roguelite wave-defense experience for solo and cooperative play. Command and survive against fast-paced escalating enemy waves, intimidating bosses, and dynamic battlefield events. Are you ready to make your final stand?

name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
summary: Sam – with companions by his side – sets out on a new journey to save humanity from extinction. Join them as they traverse a world beset by otherworldly enemies, obstacles and a haunting question: should we have connected?

name: Chained Together
summary: Из глубин ада, взбирайтесь, прикованными к цепи, с друзьями через разнообразные миры. В одиночку или в кооперативе, попытайтесь достичь вершины и узнать, что вас там ждет...

name: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward
summary: Train, fight, and rise to the top in this knockout sequel to the smashing fighter management simulator! Mentor your fighter and guide him to become the ultimate champion: choose from different combat styles, control his routine, and watch him kick some butt like a proud sensei!

name: Beast of Reincarnation
summary: Game Freak's brand-new title: Beast of Reincarnation is an action RPG with a fusion of real-time and turn-based combat. Experience the innovative "one-person, one-dog action RPG" in the beautiful yet harsh world of Beast of Reincarnation. What awaits at the end of Emma and Koo's journey?

name: Fast Food Simulator
summary: Welcome to the world's most chaotic place! Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Run a fast-food restaurant, and work with your friends to expand your business. Take orders, make burgers, and increase your earnings by dealing with customers.

name: Rusty Lake: Roots
summary: Experience the beginning and end of characters' lives and build your own family tree! Rusty Lake: Roots is the second premium point-and-click adventure by the creators of the Cube Escape series and Rusty Lake Hotel.

name: Groundwork Simulator
summary: Dig, haul and wash for gold in an open-world heavy machinery simulator. Operate excavators, wheel loaders and bulldozers, reshape the terrain and build your washing setup. Work solo or team up in online co-op to turn untouched ground into a working site.

name: Vanguard Galaxy
summary: A relaxing game about space exploration that can be played full screen or at the bottom of your screen. Trade, fight, mine and salvage your way through a procedurally generated galaxy. Let the game idle while your autopilot handles business and builds your fortune.

name: Float Lord
summary: Master awkward movement and fly higher in this physics-based balloon challenge. Push yourself away from solid ground, avoid sharps, collect colorful food, and unlock silly skins. But be careful, one pop and your hard-earned progress comes tumbling down.

name: Crash Dive
summary: WWII tactical submarine combat! Take command of a U-boat prowling the Atlantic in search of enemy convoys to sink. Sneak past the escorts and torpedo the transports. Or surface and use your deck gun in a daring night attack.

name: Sunken Engine
summary: Sunken Engine Lovecraftian Ship Repair Simulation. Restore your father’s old shipyard. Each arriving ship carries a dark mystery to be solved. Keep your customers satisfied while dealing with the strange and eerie happenings on the island.

name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
summary: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel. Join Kliff on his journey to rebuild the Greymane faction and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ruins and the mysterious Abyss, forge your path through battles and discovery.

name: Gas Guzzlers Extreme
summary: Gas Guzzlers Extreme is a fast, furious, armed-to-the-teeth, trigger-happy shooter, shifted into top gear! Take a white knuckle ride in this crazily addictive combat racing game.

name: Blood Strike
summary: Gather your friends and dive into the action-packed Battle Royale, Squad Fight, or Hot Zone like there's no tomorrow! Blood Strike offers a wide range of playable Strikers, each with a unique active and passive ability letting you deploy drones, shield walls and everything in between.

name: Avernum 2: Crystal Souls
summary: Huge indie fantasy role-playing adventure in a massive, underground land. Packed with over 100 towns and dungeons and an epic story. Fight to complete up to three distinct game-winning quests. Master over 60 spells and abilities. Hunt for hundreds of magical artifacts. Over 50 hours of gameplay.

name: Daisy Grotto
summary: In this magical world meet adorable characters and fight fierce monsters! Collect gear, craft items, and strategize - develop your party's skills and leverage their individual abilities to compete in unique hybrid real-time/turn-based combat. Can you uncover the secrets of the Daisy Grotto?

name: Hell is Us
summary: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

name: My Winter Car
summary: My Winter Car is the ultimate challenge for project car owning, building, fixing, tuning and maintenance simulator. Sequel to My Summer Car, but with added challenge for those who can master the original game!

name: Door Kickers 2: Task Force North
summary: Command military Special Ops Teams in gripping tactical combat against a Middle East-based terrorist network. Sequel to RockPaperShotgun's "Best Tactics Game of 2014".

name: Garden Galaxy
summary: Discover, collect and organise to create your own unique garden in this relaxing idle / creative sandbox!

name: JDM: Japanese Drift Master
summary: Discover Japan’s legendary car culture in JDM! Take on challenging mountain roads, visit Japanese legendary drifting spots in licensed JDM cars and immerse in the story about second chances told through manga pages. Explore an open world where every turn invites you to master the art of drift.

name: Miami Cruise
summary: Miami Cruise is a game inspired by retrowave aesthetics. Take a ride, and chill out.

name: The Caribbean Sail
summary: Name your crew, purchase supplies, sail the world, harpoon fish, plunder your enemies, die horribly, unlock a new Captain and do it all over again!

name: Stranded Deep 2
summary: Survival is just the beginning. Stranded in a desert wilderness, an endless river is your only lifeline. Scavenge resources, craft tools, and build a floating home to brave the treacherous waters and scorching heat. Every bend brings new danger and deeper discoveries. How far will you go?

name: Dream Flash
summary: Sharpen your mind and soul with hundreds of items in an infinite fast paced bullet hell rogue-lite dreamscape. Explore endless dream synergies and transform into even stronger altered states in order to combat dozens of increasingly difficult bosses.

name: Silly Polly Beast
summary: An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

name: Bang Average Football – Play, Manage, Create
summary: Celebrate the beautiful game in Bang Average Football, a fast-paced, easy-to-learn arcade football game for 1-4 players. Play with friends in co-op and PvP multiplayer, turn an underdog team into champions as player-manager in Story mode, or design your own teams, leagues, and tournaments.

name: Temple Maker 64
summary: Temple Maker 64 is a third-person dungeon creator. Build dungeons full of traps and puzzles, or grab your sword and explore community-made dungeons. Choose from a vast selection of items, monsters, puzzle elements, and bosses, all wrapped up in an N64-inspired love letter.

name: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking
creators: Julien Truebiger / Erika Zakse / Danny van Duist
summary: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking is a short physics-based cooking game full of discovery and playful chaos. Experiment with everything in the kitchen and unlock over 300 recipes on your way to becoming a master chef!

name: How to Make an Atomic Bomb in Your Garden
