summary: An absurd backyard bomb-building simulator. Raise funds, plan your approach, hunt down rare parts, and assemble your atomic masterpiece while staying calm and avoiding suspicion from nosy neighbors and federal agents.

name: Artifact Adventure
summary: The horribly toxic Swamp King has risen once again! Gather your party and set out on an open world, retro-styled, RPG adventure. Powerful mystical artifacts are scattered about the world, each able to grant you new powers. Which will you choose? What is your destiny?

name: News Tower
summary: Develop your newspaper and become New York’s new media mogul! In this tycoon, build and manage your newspaper from printer to toilet. Create your editorial line and lead your journalists through unique 1930's stories and dig out the latest scoops!

name: Temple Of Snek
summary: A snaky tile-based puzzle dungeon adventure. Defend the temple, monch the infidels, and grow and grow ...and grow?

name: ReBlade: The Death Spiral
summary: You are a condemned Synthetic, marked for destruction and trapped in endless resets. In a cyberpunk world inspired by Chinese mythology, harness weapons, chips, and augments to cut through mechanical creatures. Each run brings you closer to breaking the cycle and unravelling the truth.

name: Fruit Mountain
summary: Fruit Stacking Puzzle Game Connect the same types of fruit together to make them grow bigger and bigger! Stack them up without letting them overflow from the plate, and build your own Fruit Mountain!

name: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster
creators: Nightdive Studios / Looking Glass Studios / Irrational Games
summary: System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster is a genre defining experience that established innovative game-play mechanics that are a staple of the FPS and RPG genre today. Survive the wretched corridors of the Von Braun. Your training has prepared you for this.

name: Sex, Secrets & Used Tech
summary: In this second-hand electronics shop, every discarded device holds unspeakable secrets. You will unlock privacy, manipulate information, and even use “special transactions” to make them submit to your terms… This is a game of desire and control—are you ready to make the trade?

name: GUITAR WORKSHOP
summary: Guitar Workshop is a hyper-realistic luthier simulation. Restore, customize, and refine instruments with screw-by-screw mechanics. Expand your workshop, master specialized workstations, and build your legendary guitar collection in your journey to become a master craftsman.

name: FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO: Maiden of Black Water
summary: “FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO: Maiden of Black Water” comes to Steam for the first time to celebrate the 20th anniversary of the horror-adventure series FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO. The game is set on sacred Mt. Hikami, a site of many mysterious and terrifying incidents.

name: Half Sword
summary: Half Sword is a physics-based medieval combat simulator featuring historically accurate XV-century arms and armor. We are not afraid to show the brutal nature of medieval combat with in-depth blood and gore features.

name: UNKNOWN REGION
summary: You are one of the chosen survivors to set up your life in UNKNOWN REGION. Life has forever changed after an unknown virus has wiped out humanity. Navigate through the region to discover mutated humans and creatures. You will be challenged to test your survival skills.

name: Totem TD
summary: Build your totem from cards, defend against waves of enemies, and grow your deck in this roguelite tower defense adventure. Strategize, rotate, survive, repeat!

name: Swift by Knight
summary: Swift by Knight is a 2D platformer that puts you in control of Jack, the Nimble Knight, on a quest for speed and precision. Bounce off enemies, grapple, and utilize the unique level mechanics to navigate with speed and finesse.

name: Alchemist: The Potion Monger
summary: First-person Alchemist Simulator with RPG elements. Explore the world, gather ingredients, and sell or use potions you craft to help others and fend off enemies. Adopt pets to help you with your alchemy knowledge (and to pet them). Decorate your home however you like and brew your destiny!

name: The Drifting Crown
summary: A Victorian-era steampunk, action adventure game with roguelike elements where death is inevitable, monsters get nastier every run, and your noble quest to reopen the only pub left standing. Build your way to success, upgrade your skill tree to become more powerful, dispatch your enemies in style!

name: Crime Simulator
summary: You’re out of jail, but the debt isn’t gone. Sneak, steal, and break into houses solo or in 4-player co-op. Use lockpicks, sleeping gas, and brute force to complete jobs, outsmart security, and make enough money before time runs out. Will you pay back what you owe, or lose everything?

name: Pistol Cat
summary: Like Animal Crossing but really stupid and physics based. You are a heavily armed cat exploring a cozy yet chaotic open world island town. Discover items that give you abilities, get rich, collect custom costumes & accessories, farm, complete quests for your neighbors, unlock upgrades, and more!

name: Joint Task Force
summary: Joint Task Force is the real-time strategy (RTS) game where you command the frontline forces in tomorrow's most hazardous conflicts. Lead twenty dramatic missions in explosive war-zones including the Middle East, Central Asia, and the Balkans.

name: DungeonBox
summary: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

name: Relic Abyss
summary: Experience a unique hand-crafted Bullet Heaven Roguelite RPG set in a Fantasy x Sci-fi world filled with 💪might, 🪄magic, and 🎡lost technology! A mysterious tale centered around a world-devouring Abyss awaits...🦑🌎

name: Crafting Idle Clicker
summary: Craft a complex production line, earn idle cash and become an industrial tycoon!

name: Ghost Dimension
summary: A space pilot lost in the space needs to collect solar essence to stay alive while fighting to stay sane. A psychological journey about solitude with an original soundtrack.

name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
summary: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

name: Angel Clicker
summary: It's Heaven vs. Hell in the annual Soul-Catching Contest...and there's an office-wide pizza party at stake! Angel Clicker is a short, relaxed incremental with (optional) rhythm elements. Build quirky buildings, collect divine resources, get attacked by aliens, and... Go on a date?!

name: Tunnel Escape
summary: Embark on a daring journey with Beatrice as you kick, shoot, and loot through a secret underground lab. In this rogue-lite RPG/ADV, engage in strategic combat and face intense encounters and unspeakable dangers!

name: float: champions
summary: float champions is an intense skill based platformer where players race to become the king of the hill. Knock down those who oppose you by launching anvils or dishing out slaps as you fight to stay at the top.

name: Swim Meet
summary: There's nothing better than swimming with a variety of women. Work hard and play hard with these beautiful swimmers to ensure the best of endings together as you compete for a place on the team.

name: Yora Emerald
summary: Yora Emerald is a mature 2.5D sci-fi action-platformer and Metroidvania. Play as Yora, an operative tasked with rescuing her sister-clone, Hana, from a clandestine base. Stop the mad scientist from executing the "Emerald Ascension," a forced genetic transformation of humanity.

name: Speed Stars
summary: Simple but challenging rhythm-based running game. Compete to achieve the highest rank, unlock more characters, set personal bests, and climb the leaderboards.

name: Kingdom Rush  - Tower Defense
summary: Get ready for an epic journey to defend your kingdom against hordes of orcs, trolls, evil wizards and other nasty fiends using a vast arsenal of towers and spells at your command!Fight on forests, mountains and wastelands, customizing your defensive strategy with different tower upgrades and specializations!

name: Femboy Ghost
summary: Femboy Ghost is a casual adult game set in a fictional corporation that allows you to possess the bodies of your coworkers up to the president. The main goal is to fully corrupt the same people in the office who exposed you. What will you do once you possess their bodies?

name: Train Simulator Classic
summary: The ultimate railway hobby for more than 15 years! From historic steam locomotives to modern high-speed and heavy freight trains, and routes around the world, Train Simulator Classic is the simulation made by railfans for railfans.

name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

name: Fuck This Job
summary: Play as Jake, a janitor threatened to be replaced by AI machines, then subsequently fired.Grab your super vacuum cleaner, use it to hoover and destroy everything in your path in this AI-infected company! Shoot and kick everything that is in your path to show your capabilities as a great employee.

name: Jungle Rumble
summary: Become a fearless soldier, face off against the evil Skull and his army in the heart of the Amazon jungle. Survive deadly traps, ambushes, and explosive battles to restore peace. Will you emerge victorious?

name: The Mercenary Rise
summary: It tells the story of Stephen Gray, who inherited his father's legacy and managed the Mercenary Corps of Thunder Anger.

name: Train Station Tycoon
summary: A punctual train is never an accident. In this immersive management game, take control of a bustling railway station with your friends. Assign platforms, coordinate teams, expand your infrastructure from 2 to 30 tracks, and manage real-time crises to keep the traffic flowing smoothly!

name: Crystal Clash
summary: Crystal Clash is a mix of Lane Battles and Deckbuilding - with action-packed tug-of-war strategy, just like your favorite RTS mods from back in the day! :) Play 2v2 or co-op with a friend, or pair up with new allies and enemies! Collect cards, build your decks and have fun crushing your enemies!

name: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
summary: Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him. Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.

name: The Spell Brigade
summary: Survivors-like with ONLINE CO-OP for 1-4 players. Team up with your wizard friends to slay hordes of dark creatures. Complete team-based objectives, unlock new upgrades and create overpowered spell synergies. Friend nor foe is safe in this friendly fire bullet hell!

name: College Basketball Manager
summary: Take charge as head coach in College Basketball Manager. Recruit your dream team, whether that be through All-Americans or hidden gems. Strategize gameplay, schedule games, run practices, and manage your staff, because you are in control. The court is your canvas – create a powerhouse.

name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO
summary: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Make yours the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball!

name: Dungeon Defenders II
summary: Dungeon Defenders II is a cooperative Action Tower Defense game packed with roleplaying elements like loot, leveling, and pets.

name: Moon Mystery
summary: The Moon's haunted - and when an astronaut loses contact with Earth, the adventure begins in full. Fill up your oxygen, load up the guns, and set out on an interstellar FPS adventure across the stars, filled with puzzles, fights, exploration, and strange secrets of the universe.

name: Frantic Dimension
summary: Frantic Dimension is a retro twin-stick shooter inspired by the earliest twin-sticks, 'Space Dungeon' and 'Robotron 2084'. Never stop moving and shooting... or you'll die.

name: Angel Legion
summary: Idle or play whenever and wherever you want. Customize the looking of your favorite Angels. Automatically accumulate resources all the time.

name: Task Force Admiral - Vol.1: American Carrier Battles
summary: Experience the thrill of leading American aircraft carriers to victory in this innovative full 3D command simulation wargame set in the Pacific in 1942. First-person or God’s eye, you lead your fleet and planes right from the center of the battle.

name: Make Sail
summary: ﻿Make boats and sail them. Survive an ocean of storms and beasts to find better pieces to make your ship bigger, faster, stronger, prettier, stranger, wilder: more yours.

name: SKULL CHAINZ
summary: Smash your way through Hell in this unique physics-based combat game! Face down the 7 Deadly Circles of Sin and their all-powerful Lords!

name: Hi-Fi RUSH
summary: Test your abilities in two new game modes, uncover new rewards and even a few secrets in the Arcade Challenge! Update! Feel the beat as wannabe rockstar Chai and his ragtag team fight against an evil megacorp in a world that syncs to the music.

name: Stream Avatars
summary: Stream Avatars is a content creation tool for live video broadcasting that adds flair to your video to promote viewer engagement and channel growth! Viewers can also spend their hard-earned stream currency on avatar customizations.

name: Amulet Zero 零物语 - Optimize
summary: 某一天，一觉醒来的朵琳，发现自己正置身于这个陌生的小岛上， 独自在树林里走着，没走多远，她遇上了一个哭得很伤心的女孩子，她叫杰西卡……

name: Clay Vessels
summary: This is a fast-paced, multiplayer RTS with a unique economy focus. Automate factories to out-produce your opponents. Up to 4 players are currently supported, and the game has a very approachable learning curve.

name: Bulby - Diamond Course
summary: Bulby - Diamond Course is a colorful 3D Platformer inspired by a classic old 16-bit game. Bulby features tons of levels in Story Mode, Coop, Multiplayer, and a built-in Course Editor to create your own courses and share with the internet.

name: System Shock: Enhanced Edition
summary: Re-discover what made System Shock the first of it's kind, a ground breaking immersive sim that would inspire a generation of games to come....

name: Cyberpunk Brothel 🤖
summary: Alex is a pro hacker, but he’s also known on the darker parts of the web, seeking out corporate fraud and instigating acts of shadow code that would make others cringe if they knew. However, his hobbies make him a true sexual deviant, and now his AI partners may be coming into their own reality!

name: Cybernetic Strategy
summary: Cybernetic Strategy is an elite, tactical Sci-Fi Auto Battler where you must craft a legion of Robots within the Dominion in order to be The Strongest. Calcuate the most superior strategies to triumph over all as you utilize the power of Magic, Armoury or Brute force to win!

name: Chiptune Champion
summary: Transform your keyboard into an instrument and play along to the melody of catchy chiptunes in this challenging rhythm game. Now with tap mode!

name: A Date with Death
summary: Fight against & romance the one hunting for your soul in A Date with Death, a romance chat simulator where you date(?) the Grim Reaper himself. Create your own character, decorate your apartment, and chat away with the charming yet dangerous Grim Reaper through text and video calls.

name: Lost Dimension
summary: In the near future a terrorist mastermind, known only as ‘The End’, threatens humanity with nuclear armageddon. A special task force, the S.E.A.L.E.D team, are the only ones who can stop him: a group of young combatants with incredible abilities and each with a mysterious past.

name: Jump Dash Soar
summary: Jump Dash Soar is a frenetic, fast, and fun movement-based FPS. Build incredible speed with a powerful dash mechanic combined with rocket jumping, strafe running, slope jumps, and bounce pads!

name: Mystical Demon Farm
summary: Mystical Demon Farm is a cute, cozy, but lively farm game that blends farming simulation, monster collecting, and dungeon crawling. Collect Demons, grow your operation, and build an amazing farm worthy of the Queen’s recognition!

name: Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking
summary: In this absurd co-op horror game you are medieval monks--and the only chefs who can prevent the apocalypse. Feed enormous monsters with a catapult, evade supernatural enemies, and navigate a reality-bending labyrinth with up to 4+ players!

name: Supermarket Simulator
summary: Run your own supermarket! Stock shelves, set your prices, take payments, hire staff, expand your store, handle shoplifters, and design your layout. Purchase goods from online or local markets around town, and personally deliver online orders to your customers.

name: System Crash
summary: System Crash is a story-driven cyberpunk collectible card game inspired by Blade Runner and Neuromancer. When corporations own everything and the line between man and machine is blurred, your only option is to fight to survive!

name: Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE
summary: No matter how much times passes... I remember that blue, blue summer. Summer Pockets, the midsummer story brought to you by Key, has been powered-up with even more to play, including new heroines and routes, in Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE, now available on Steam!

name: Restaurant Scramble
summary: Run your own diner, patisserie, seafood store, and more in this fast-paced incremental game! Keep your customers happy by updating your menu and upgrading a variety of skills.

name: The Sinking City 2
summary: Set in the Roaring '20s, The Sinking City 2 is a survival horror steeped in Lovecraftian dread. Defy an eldritch deity and explore the drowned alleys of Arkham, stalked by the dead, as you weigh one life against an entire city.

name: Food Chain
summary: Full Physics Massive Multiplayer.

name: How to Train Your Spirit: The Exorcism of a Busty Ghost
summary: Set in the Edo period, you are the last Onmyoji, called to an eerie estate for an exorcism. The source is a lewd, busty female spirit. As the final master of a forbidden art, your goal is to bring spirits to climax and purify them. Yet this one feels different… a hidden truth lies beneath.

name: Set Sail
summary: Set Sail is a western visual novel set in the modern day where the Golden Age of Pirating never properly ended. You get to meet characters interested in the world of piracy and choose how your days on the main land go.

name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
summary: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

name: Ruby: Tunnel Vision
summary: A science fiction FPS game where you fight, explore, and outsmart your way through an alien invasion. Built as a mod for the Source engine.

name: Marie Android
summary: Do you like Marie‑chan? You play as Marie Android, a small girl‑like robot who meets many friends. Using mysterious powers, she can become muscular, flatten into a paper‑thin form, or transform into a giant tank to fight enemies. Borrow your friends’ abilities and save Akacha Town.

name: Town of Sins
summary: Town of Sins is a cheeky card game with a unique battle system. Corrupt the city you stumble upon and recruit innocent babes to turn them into powerful women. Upgrade your cards, engage in steamy battles, enjoy epic adventures, and collect the sexiest girls.

name: Military Conflict: Vietnam
summary: It’s 1968 in Vietnam, the time to “Make War Not Love”. Side with the Viet Cong or U.S. Army in this intense, fast-paced FPS set in the Vietnam War — now with co-op zombie mode. Choose from 300+ weapons of destruction. Kill or be killed!

name: The Last Spell
summary: Defend the last bastion of humanity with your squad of heroes! Exterminate fiendish monsters with magic and brute force by night and re-build your battered city defenses by day in this tactical RPG with rogue-lite mechanics.

name: Sword & Soil
summary: Farm, fish, fight and explore, and turn all of it into better gear. Sell your harvest, your catch and what monsters drop, then buy the armor the next road demands. Real-time combat: read the wind-up, step off the red tiles, strike back. Four classes, puzzle dungeons and five towns to reach.

name: HER TREES : PUZZLE DREAM
summary: HER TREES : PUZZLE DREAM is a unique point-and-click puzzle game where you move and combine objects to solve puzzles. Unravel the strange puzzles hidden in your dreams.

name: The Last Gas Station
summary: In a world where electric cars reign supreme, you are now the owner of an old gas station out in the wilderness. Establish trade, develop your business and uncover the secret of this strange place in the compact gas station simulator.

name: Moss Palace Parade
summary: 謎に満ちた施設「モスパレス」を探索し、貴女と世界に秘められた謎を解き明かそう

name: Dolls' Domain
summary: You find yourself in a dollhouse - can you escape, or will you meet your fate? Navigate through the escape room-style puzzles, and avoid being caught by the creatures who exist in this place, and gain your freedom from the dollhouse!

name: SWIFT STRIDERS PARKOUR
summary: SWIFT STRIDERS is a parkour game using unreal engine 5 latest technologies it has freeruning, vaults, tic tac, flips, climbing and more, there are also multiple maps to play so you wont get bored. There are multiple characters to chose from.

name: Banners of Ruin
summary: Assemble your party. Answer the call. Win the war. Build a deck and fight a series of turn-based combats with up to 6 party characters through the city of Dawn's Point. Each character can unlock a set of unique cards and abilities that can augment your deck in powerful, exciting ways.

name: Mummy Sandbox
summary: Mummy Sandbox is a first person digging simulator meets point & click adventure. Traverse forgotten sandboxes and dig up corpses to learn their secrets!

name: Lost Flame
summary: Lost Flame is a modern roguelike game featuring unique and challenging turn-based combat. Find your way in the ruined kingdom of Hiraeth while fighting against legendary warriors of the past and spawn of the unfathomable Abysm.

name: Dash Dash World
summary: Drive, Shoot & Drift like NEVER before. Dash Dash is a cross-platform VR racing game with full hand driving and weapons controls. Over 100 hours of gameplay contents including story mode, regular online tournaments, 100s of achievements and trillion+ customizable parts.

name: Lowpoly Drifting
summary: Lowpoly drift games use simplified graphics for a distinct look. Players control a car and aim to drift through turns for points and the best score, requiring skillful driving to balance speed and control.

name: Puzzle Agent
summary: Created with indie comic artist Graham Annable's unique narrative and visual sensibilities, delivered with the distinctive Telltale storytelling style, Puzzle Agent is sure to challenge, thrill and engage in more ways than you can shake a cryptogram at!

name: Hammer Heads Deluxe
summary: Pesky yard gnomes are invading your lawn! The only way to stop them is with a swift hammer blow to the head. Bash gnomes as quickly as you can while keeping an eye out for special gnomes, prizes and power-ups! Earn gold coins and shop the shiny store for upgrades.

name: Zombies Aren't Real
summary: Zombies aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you deploy military forces in an attempt to quell a quick-spreading zombie infection and save as many civilians as you can!

name: Hammer 2
summary: Hammer 2 is an action game in the third person where you will incarnate Hammer a hero of modern times! Take your rifle and kill anyone who gets in your way!

name: The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake
summary: The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake is a story driven tactical RPG that brings a long cherished SRPG classic back to life. Set in a vast fantasy world shaped by ancient wars, the game weaves together turn based tactical combat and character focused storytelling, where every decision carries weight.

name: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
summary: 在这个充满危险的开放世界游戏中搜刮物资，建造你的避难所，生产食物并管理资源。独自一人或通过合作模式，对抗僵尸、敌对人类，以及随着迷雾而不断加剧的威胁，努力活下去。

name: WORLD OF HORROR
summary: Experience the quiet terror of this 1-bit love letter to Junji Ito and H.P. Lovecraft. Navigate a hellish roguelite reality with turn-based combat and unforgiving choices. Experiment with your deck of event cards to discover new forms of cosmic horror in every playthrough. The inevitable awaits...

name: The Sink Gods
summary: The Sink Gods is a modern adventure game. You play a poor villager who lives in the Sink Valley. When you are evicted from your home, you realise your only hope is the Sink Gods of the Great Basin. Journey to each of their temples, and pass their test to gain revenge for what you have lost.

name: Digimon Story Time Stranger
summary: The latest in the Digimon Story series is finally here! In this RPG, unravel a mystery that spans across the human world and the Digital World, collecting and raising a wide variety of Digimon to save the world.

name: Puzzle Box Palace
summary: Puzzle Box Palace is an escape room style puzzle game where you are pulled into your grandfather's magical puzzle box. Solve puzzles, manipulate the puzzle box, and jump across furniture as you look for a way out.

name: Shield Operator
summary: Defend the skies against enemy missiles, drones, and aircraft! Deploy modern air defense systems, calculate trajectories, and destroy aerial targets in real time. Become an impenetrable shield for your territory. Repel any aerial threat with a decisive response!

name: Basketball Babe
summary: Basketball Babe is a fast paced arcade basketball shooting game. Hone your basketball shooting skill in the different scenes to get high score.

name: Shotgun Farmers
summary: Shotgun Farmers is the multplayer shooter where missed shots grow guns. Fire your bullets into the ground to plant your ammo. The longer a gun plant grows the more ammo you will get!

name: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos
summary: Step into the wacky heroic fantasy universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Lead a team of unlikely and clumsy heroes in an epic and challenging tactical RPG. Live an adventure filled with humor, surprises and silly encounters.

name: Paleo Dive
summary: Explore five prehistoric oceans on desktop or in VR. Photograph 48 species from three perspectives, collect DNA samples, and expand your walk-in aquarium. Upgrade your equipment and return to base before your oxygen runs out.

name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines
summary: Vampire®: The Masquerade-Bloodlines™ delivers a new type of RPG experience-one that blends all the core elements of a traditional RPG with the graphical richness, immediacy and brutal combat of a first-person action game. The game plunges players into the dark and gritty vampire underworld of modern-day L.A. as a creature of the night.

name: Knight Online
summary: The Great Battle between Karus and El Morad has arrived to Steam! Pledge allegiance to one of the Nations and put your skills to the test in one of the best PvP system in the MMORPG universe!

name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Party Dash
summary: A colorful cast of pixel-art Umamusume are all in line and ready to compete in the Slapdash Grand Prix, a school festival featuring four zany events! Which team will run, shoot, and eat their way to gold and glory?

name: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 1
summary: The renowned Mega Man Battle Network series is back! Vol. 1 contains Mega Man Battle Network 1-3, including both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 3 for a total of four titles, plus additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! In addition, online play is supported!

name: Arrow Heads
summary: Grab your friends, neighbors, extended family and that handsome cashier from the grocery store and get ready for some sweet, award-winning, couch and online multiplayer. With your trusty bow, shoot, dodge and deflect arrows in this zany isometric archery game.

name: BARDA: Backpack Roguelike
summary: In BARDA, it won't be your sword that saves you. It's how you pack your bag. But hunger, fatigue and madness will take up space! Do your best as you climb an ever-changing mountain to spread the ashes of your grandfather, improve your base camp, and try again.

name: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD-
summary: A thousand adventures in one! — Discover the roots of the Mystery Dungeon series. Packed with the challenge, tension, and rewarding gameplay of a classic roguelike adventure, this is a journey we're excited for a new generation of players take on!

name: WORK WORK WORK
summary: WORK. DIE. REPEAT. Can you break out from the sinister cycle of "WORK WORK WORK"? Explore the Triquetra company to find clues, gather information, and discover the truth about the meaning in working, and living.

name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
summary: Collect hundreds of thousands of golf balls, earn money, buy new tools, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER is an active incremental game centered on the quiet satisfaction of tidying up.

name: The Enchanted Cave 2
summary: Uncover the dark secrets of a cave with an endless supply of monsters and loot!

name: Budget Cuts 2: Mission Insolvency
summary: Built from the ground-up for Virtual Reality, Budget Cuts 2 is an action-adventure stealth game where you zip, sneak, and stab your way through enemy-filled offices, trains, warehouses, and skyscrapers to take down the evil efficiency robots at TransCorp.

name: Potion Knight
summary: Potion Knight is an intense and up-tempo first-person shooter that combines the need for speed with tactical potion throwing. Set in the harsh snow ridden village of Cronenberg where an unorthodox alchemist has been fusing animals with weapons to fight under his command.

name: Emerald Blue
summary: The Swan EM-43DSC... A experimental fighter jet blasts through the skies of the New East/West. And as the pilot clutches her yoke, she commits to her rebellion knowing full well, that her mission is not for the faint of heart....

name: Pangea: Chronicles of the Lost Continent
summary: Frank Frantic starts out in a junk shop and ends up on a continent from 335 million years ago. In between: a woman who hits VERY hard, a millionaire with too many secrets and a stone god with a broken heart. A point & click adventure with sharp humor, barrel-aged for 20 years.

name: Duck Detective: The Secret Salami
summary: Solving crime is no walk in the pond. You are a down-on-his-luck detective who also happens to be a duck. Use your powers of de-duck-tion to inspect evidence, fill in the blanks, and bust the case wide open! This is a short but twisty detective case.

name: Cursor Charm
summary: Attach physics-based charms to your cursor. Customize their appearance, effects, and behavior, or import your own PNGs and create something uniquely yours.

name: Territory: Farming and Warfare
summary: From a small village of a dozen people to a small kingdom of thousands of people. Arrange for residents to work, gathering, fishing and hunting, farming and mining, processing and manufacturing. Trade, accumulate supplies, increase your strength, and fight evil forces and monsters.

name: Mexican Ninja
summary: Become the Mexican Ninja and fight to take back Nuevo Tokyo, where Narcos and Yakuzas have fused into the ruthless Narkuzas. Master slick combos, unleash outrageous Mexican Jutsus and craft deadly builds in this fast, chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up.

name: Super Pilot
summary: Super Pilot is a F-Zero inspired arcade futuristic racer that lets you create, edit and share your tracks in the blink of an eye.

name: Gray Zone Warfare
summary: Enter a high-stakes PvE-first open-world tactical shooter set on a quarantined Southeast Asian island torn apart by faction warfare. Deploy as an elite operator, fight solo or with your squad to carry out missions, earn reputation, and explore the truth behind the Event igniting the conflict.

name: CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic
summary: Empire Club. The most luxurious bar that ladies and gentlemen come and gather. The beautiful maids who worked there danced and talked with the customers to amuse them.

name: Spirit Island
summary: Become the spirits of the land, and defend the island from colonizing Invaders spreading blight and destruction! Your spirits work with the native islanders to increase your power and drive the invading colonists from your island in this strategic area-control game.

name: Crimen - Mercenary Tales
summary: Raise yer glasses high, me hearties! Embark on a (bloody) journey through eight swashbucklin' tales of grandeur, riches, and legendary feats! Experience visually captivating comic book graphics, while being entertained by the mercenary humor of the tavern’s patrons and their over-the-top deeds!

name: Waterfalls Dream
summary: Waterfalls Dream is an expressive diorama-builder with realistic water behavior. Build your own cozy waterfalls and watch water find its path among the nature scenery. Relax without any goal and paint in a 3D world full of procedural helpers. Imagine a new place - or recreate the one you saw before.

name: Axis Football 2027
summary: Axis Football 2027 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.

name: Polyville Canyon
summary: Polyville Canyon is a laid-back city builder where nothing bad ever happens! Relax while you build an entire city for your Neighbors piece by piece! Attract Neighbors and increase Ticket Prices by expanding your town and watch your profits soar!

name: Retro Gadgets
summary: Retro Gadgets is a sandbox where you build, code, and customize gadgets inspired by old-school electronics.

name: Ultra Cop
summary: A challenging retro arcade FPS/TPS straight from the late '90s. The Crime Wars have started and it's up to the Ultra Cops to bring back ultimate justice. Use Mechs, Riot Cars and serious firepower to bring the pain to the criminal underworld in this 6th Generation Y2K inspired game.

name: Idle Cave Miner
summary: Idle Cave Miner is an idle game about crafting items, mining gems, and building your team of miners. Prestige, craft, and travel to other mines to increase your strength to dig deeper, and find what lurks below.

name: AUDICA: Rhythm Shooter
summary: AUDICA™ is a VR “rhythm shooter” that combines Harmonix’s award-winning music gameplay with precision shooting mechanics and a 33-song soundtrack, all set in a mesmerizing cosmic arena.

name: K-9 Dog Job
summary: K-9 Dog Job - simple runner game. Now you play as a dog and your goal collect bones.

name: Metropolis 1998
summary: A fresh, modern city builder with charming aesthetics. Detailed agent-based simulation and scheduling. See inside buildings. Design and customize almost anything. Business-specific zoning, and mixed use zones too!

name: Prison Of Sissy
summary: A young man enters prison after a desperate mistake — but the real transformation has already begun. An adult visual novel about identity, survival, and unexpected desire.

name: Sakura Swim Club
summary: In Sakura Swim Club, follow the story of Kaede, just your average guy. Upon transferring to a new school, he meets two beautiful girls in the swim club. Things haven't gone well for the swim club lately, but with Kaede's help, that all changes.

name: Helmet Head
summary: Helmet Head is an action-roguelike with a 2D souls-lite combat style. Build your strength on each run by finding weapons, helmets, upgrades and items in randomly generated environments, and use them in clever ways to defeat your foes! Death wipes the slate clean. Keep learning, never stop fighting!

name: Maximum Action
summary: MAXIMUM Action is a brutal and satisfying physics-based first person shooter influenced by Hong Kong cinema, heroic slow motion bloodshed, and old-school FPS ACTION.

name: Modulus: Factory Automation
summary: Build, automate, & optimize production lines across sky islands with real spatial constraints. Every production line is an open-ended puzzle: which operators to use, how to route your belts and how to fit your factory into the landscape. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

name: Grim Hammer
summary: Stop the stone golem and his army using powerful upgrades. Crush enemies with your hammer, earn gold, and unlock new abilities to defeat waves of monsters.

name: Ultrapolis
summary: A cyberpunk city diorama with millions of possible buildings. No city management between you and pure layout and design.

name: Risky Business
summary: A fast-paced adult clicker where every tap brings stunning bombshells to life. Unlock animated scenes, grow your gallery, and enjoy a sleek, one-hand thrill packed with fun stories, gorgeous girls, and very spicy visuals.

name: Arrow Sudoku
summary: In Arrow Sudoku, every puzzle contains a handful of "arrows" laid out in unique patterns. The numbers found along the shaft of the arrow must sum up to the number at the base. This simple rule leads to endless variety in the puzzles you will conquer.

name: RPG Maker MV
creators: Gotcha Gotcha Games / KADOKAWA / Yoji Ojima
summary: POWERFUL enough for a developer SIMPLE enough for a child VERSATILE enough for any platform!RPG MAKER MV allows you to make the RPG of your dreams! This latest version includes a host of new featuresand export options for MacOSX, Android, and iPhone!

name: The Gold River Project
summary: The Gold River Project™ is a camping trip gone wrong in the Pacific Northwest. Explore, craft, build, and survive in this open-world experiment that traps you and up to 4 friends in this single player or co-op survival adventure game.

name: Fantasy World Manager
summary: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

name: Cursed Treasure 2
summary: Why be good when you can be... bad? Cursed Treasure 2 is an addictive tower-defense game that puts the power of darkness at your fingertips. Build towers of powerful orcs, demons, and undead, and master powerful spells, to protect your precious hoard from all manner of no-good do-gooders.

name: Summer Memories
summary: It's summer break, and it's been years since you've last seen your aunt and cousins in the countryside! You don't know what to expect, but what could go wrong? Find out in Summer Memories!

name: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin
summary: A new adventure awaits you in this second installment of the turn-based RPG series set in the world of Monster Hunter! Become a Rider and form bonds with friendly monsters known as Monsties to fight alongside them as you take part in an epic story.

name: Stacks:Jungle!
summary: Stacks:Jungle is an engaging adventure card game set in the lush heart of the jungle. Unlock new cards with booster packs, combine them to uncover craft recipes, build amazing structures, venture into uncharted territories, make new friends, discover hidden treasures, and so much more!

name: Wild Dive
summary: Reach the highest score by dodging obstacles, leaping across ravines, sliding down slopes, etc ... Watch your step!

name: Grandma Left Me A Building
summary: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

name: Mind Over Magic
summary: Mind Over Magic is a colony sim set at the site of a cursed magic school. Build and optimize your own magical academy, train powerful Mages, and master mighty relics in order to battle through the Underschool, a mysterious underground dungeon that holds the key to liberation from a deadly curse.

name: Colony City 27λ
summary: Colony City 27λ is an adult Rougelite game that combines simple card and complex skill set. In the story, there are plenty of challenging malevolent criminals, tentacle creatures, and mechanical enemies. Your battle performance during the adventure will determine the final ending!

name: Extreme Forklifting 2
summary: Always dreamed of becoming a forklift operator? Now you can!

name: Golden Gloves VR
summary: Golden Gloves VR Boxing Game (Officially Licensed)

name: Disney Dreamlight Valley
summary: Relax in a cozy world filled with the magic of Disney and Pixar! Discover rich stories and build the perfect Valley alongside more than 50 heroes and villains in this life-sim adventure game.

name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
summary: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
summary: A drifting simulator featuring an authentic competition format and a judging system inspired by modern drift championships. Enhanced and updated physics, developed in collaboration with the CarX Motorsport team.

name: My Little Cosmos
summary: My Little Cosmos is a light idle clicker game that runs quietly in the background. Keyboard input and mouse clicks from everyday computer use automatically drive the evolution of a universe, with inventory rewards dropping over time.

name: Odd Town
summary: Odd Town is a story-driven first-person adventure about being stuck in a town where everything feels just a little wrong. Explore a handcrafted, bite-sized town, meet suspicious locals, take odd jobs, dodge cops, become a conspiracy theorist, and steal sandwiches.

name: Dark Continent
summary: A fast-paced action MMORPG where every strike is aimed and every dodge matters. Take on epic bosses, experience responsive real-time combat, and enjoy full control—no tab-targeting, no auto-play, and no Pay2Win.

name: Crafting Town
summary: Crafting Town Is : A Crafting game with Simulation&Building where you can Craft and Develop your Village, Source Management and Quests.

name: Rune Factory 5
summary: As the newest ranger of a peacekeeping organization known as SEED, protect your community by rounding up rowdy monsters and going on special missions. Cultivate your farm and friendships alike while unravelling rune-related mysteries!

name: The Lab
summary: Welcome to The Lab, a compilation of Valve’s room-scale VR experiments set in a pocket universe within Aperture Science. Fix a robot, defend a castle, adopt a mechanical dog, and more. Still not sold? It’s free!

name: Conqueror's Blade
summary: Conqueror's Blade gives you a chance to be a true warlord. Commanding medieval troops in epic 15 vs. 15 siege battles, conquering cities with allies in the open world or fighting against players from all over the world – it's you who make the choice.

name: Good Pizza, Great Pizza - Cooking Simulator Game
summary: Ready to settle in with a soothing shift behind the counter? Feel the dough, hear the quiet crackle of the oven, and serve warm slices to grateful guests. Good Pizza, Great Pizza is the cozy, asmr-friendly escape you didn’t know you kneaded.

name: Guhe Township Waterfall
summary: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

name: TRIANGLE STRATEGY
summary: A new tactics RPG from the team who brought you the Bravely series and Octopath Traveler. An epic tale, brought to life with stunning HD-2D graphics. Make difficult decisions in this story set against a backdrop of the war-torn continent of Norzelia.

name: Rain98
summary: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

name: Concrete Jungle
summary: A city planning deck-building game. Place buildings using cards in your deck and earn new ones as you progress! A genre-blending game packed with cool ideas that swaps micro-management for a more puzzle-like approach to city planning.
